description:
Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape. Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon’s relentless struggle to break free.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: Melting Point แมตช์เปลี่ยนหัวใจ

description:
After twelve years, a former teammate—no, a thorn in his side—suddenly reappears. Eun-San isn’t thrilled to be working with Ian again, having long buried both his ice hockey past and any memories of him. 

Unlike Eun-San, who hopes their meeting will be a one-time thing, Ian insists on keeping him around with an offer he can’t refuse. With his beloved younger sibling caught in the middle, Eun-San reluctantly agrees, but he can't shake the feeling that Ian has an ulterior motive. 

Why does Ian keep pulling him closer? There’s no way this guy actually has feelings for him…right? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Đại Phản Diện Khao Khát Được Sống

description:
Fresh out of a breakup, game developer Woo-Jin has little going for him. So when he hears that the middle boss of their game is based on him, he can't resist adding a few traits to make his virtual alter ego a tad more noble. Little did he know, he would soon end up trapped in said villain's skin! With a 1 in 1,000 chance of survival, Woo-Jin now has to navigate the countless variables leading him to his impending doom. Will the tweaks he made to the character tip the scales in his favor?

(Source: Tapas)

description:
Who was that guy that once said, “An army marches on its stomach”? When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG “Paladins of Blood” to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As a top-tier film star, Jae-Gyu is no stranger to the spotlight or the toxic rumors that follow it. Exhausted by the public eye, he has become a professional at pushing people away. That changes when he meets his neighbor, Cheong-Rok, a counselor at a psychiatry office. Cheong-Rok does not recognize the star and treats him like anyone else. Intrigued by this normal treatment, Jae-Gyu finds himself drawn to the one man unimpressed by his fame. Despite his long career, Jae-Gyu has never experienced romance, not even through a script. So is he finally ready for the real thing? 

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

隣の席のエンジニアさんが転職したいようです。

description:
Max and Joy may sit just inches apart at work, but they're miles apart in every other way. Max prefers to be a fly on the wall, while Joy is the office's social butterfly. So when Max accidentally sees something on Joy's work laptop he wasn't meant to, he's pulled off the wall and thrown straight into the tangled web of workplace dynamics. Maybe this change is exactly what he needed... or is it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: เควสต์ด้ายแดง
赤い糸クエスト〜XXでクエストを完了せよ！〜

description:
As a first-year law student, Lee Yeon never expected to cross paths again with his middle school crush — the charming upperclassman Hong Ki-Hoon. But a chance reunion on campus leads to an even more unexpected twist: a spontaneous trip, and a strange challenge known only as the Red Thread Quest. 

Red Thread Quest, Round 1: Five Kisses on the Cheek!

Skeptical about soulmates and fate, Yeon finds himself drawn into the legend of the Red Thread of Fate — and as each round of the quest unfolds, his relationship with Ki-Hoon begins to take an unpredictable turn. 

What started as a game might just lead them to something real…if the Red Thread Rock has anything to say about it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jang Baek-Hee is counting the days until he can escape Gicheon before his deadbeat father is released from prison. But then Yang Il-Woo arrives: a delinquent transfer student with a cheap perm, brassy hair, and a loneliness that mirrors Baek-Hee’s own. Slowly, their uneasy friendship deepens into something tender. But Il-Woo came to Gicheon with a secret that could shatter the fragile comfort they've both found in each other. And when the past comes calling, can two broken souls survive the truth?

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: Le chemin fleuri de la nuit blanche
บุปผาใต้คืนตะวันฉาย

description:
To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Kiss Me If You Can(キス・ミー・イフ・ユー・キャン)
キス・ミー・イフ・ユー・キャン

description:
*"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over."*

After a one-night stand Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived - something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The Chick-Class Hunter Is Being Filial!
The Chick Hunter Is Being Filial!
ひよこ組のハンターは親孝行中です！

description:
At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: ไรอันที่รัก

description:
In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled — only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor Ryan Thornton, a gruff soldier who is the opposite of the Ryan Wilgrave she knows. Little does she realize, there may be more to Ryan than meets the eye…

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: สุดยอดแม่สื่อแห่งลอนดอน
ミス・ペンドルトンの恋

description:
If love is the ultimate prize, then the perils of courtship are the necessary trials and tribulations one must endure in its pursuit. It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid’s arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city’s finest matchmaker. When Laura’s self-ascribed duties call her to befriend the stoic and saturnine Mr. Ian Dalton of Whitefield, however, she soon finds that when it comes to the grand contest of love, it may well be every woman for herself…

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world where blue snow freezes everything it touches, humanity has long forgotten what warmth feels like. Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. The snow will soon erase his footsteps but not the promise that keeps him moving.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: ไอดอลประจำกิลด์

description:
Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world’s top MMORPG, using her brother’s account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she’s mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who’s secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait… I know this girl!

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: กลลวงกลีบดอกไม้

description:
I-Yeon wanted a quiet life as an arborist—but hidden upstairs is a comatose killer who once tried to murder her. When he wakes with no memory, she panics… and lies: "I'm your wife." 

Can she survive the man who doesn’t remember her—or what he did?

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: A Reencarnação do Deus dos Punhos

description:
Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: มื้อนี้มีรัก

description:
One snowy winter evening, Chang-Deok spots a high schooler crouched in front of his favorite restaurant, blood running ice-cold in the falling snow. Lured in by the promise of meal made just like the restaurant's, Chang-Deok ends up inviting the boy—Jong-U—into his home; after all, Chang-Deok's life is as dry as day-old rice, and food is his only joy. So when Jong-U offers to cook him a delicious dinner every night in exchange for a place to stay, he reluctantly agrees. But as their unusual cohabitation begins, Changdeok can't shake this bloody feeling that Jong-U might be hiding something... Hopefully being a good Samaritan doesn’t come back around to bite him in the neck—er, butt...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

description:
Echineacea Roaz is graceful, beautiful, and impeccably dressed, even on the dueling grounds. Yet beneath the lace gloves and silk hats is a deadly swordsman with a dark secret. As the Demon of the Cursed Sword, she once slaughtered all she loved, including Captain Eurien, the one man who believed in her. Granted one chance to rewrite fate, she turns back time and joins the knighthood to protect those she once failed. Can this elegant swordsman bloom anew, or will she cut everything down again?

(Source: Tapas)

神之塔外傳：烏雷克·馬奇努

You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
When his grandfather is suddenly brutally murdered by a member of the Demonic Martial Alliance, Fu Enxue vows that he will stop at nothing to avenge his death. To find the perpetrator, he infiltrates the alliance armed only with his wits and thirst for vengeance. There, he catches the attention of the demonic masters, as his overwhelming bloodlust makes him a prodigy in the demonic arts. But will this thirst for blood help him in his pursuit of revenge, or will that same power be his undoing?

(Source: Tapas)

Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

The path to greatness begins… tomorrow! It’s always a day too early for a great procrastinator like Yeonho Wi to start training. So how did someone as lazy as him become a great warrior renowned for his virtue, benevolence, and might? Follow the historian’s journey to uncover the hidden secrets of the lazy master of martial arts.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Witness the corruption of reason and divinity. Escape the nine hells of Fog Land. Driven by his conviction that everyone deserves education, science teacher Dante Kang agrees to teach in Fog Land, a mysterious international prison that houses the world’s most notorious criminals. But his very first class gets interrupted by a violent prison riot, after which, he finds himself in the cell of his mysterious captor. Dante must now travel through the nine circles of hell and escape Fog Land. 

Source: Webtoon

Geon-Yeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons. Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geon-Yeong's journey to prove that despite the disadvantages life has dealt her, she is worthy of respect. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

ダイヤモンド・ダスト (C.R Jade)

Having lived as a beta his whole life, Seo Yee-Hyeon never imagined his path would cross with a golden Alpha like Liu Weikun - someone so far above his world it, felt like fate would never even bother. But one day, Weikun catches an impossible scent adrift in the air: the sweet, addictive pheromone of an Omega…coming from Hyun. Stranger still, it’s a scent only he can perceive. As desire and instinct blur into obsession, Yee-Hyeon finds himself caught between disbelief and temptation, his world crystalizing into one he never thought possible…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sang-Hyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman? Sang-Hyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!

Yeo Eun-Seong has always been popular—too popular. With his striking looks, he attracts attention from everyone, regardless of age or gender. But constant gossip and misunderstandings have left him deeply distrustful of people. The last thing he needs is to be popular amongst ghosts too!

After moving into a new home for his job, Eun-Seong finds himself tormented by eerie paranormal activity night after night. One evening, while cowering outside his own apartment, he meets Seo Tae-Jeong, a passing office worker who—much to Eun-Seong’s surprise—can see and talk to ghosts. Desperate for peace, Eun-Seong enlists Tae-Jeong’s help to rid his house of its unwelcome guests. As the two work together, an unexpected and curious friendship begins to take shape… but is there more to Tae-Jeong than meets the eye?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ketal the Barbarian never imagined that his dream of fantastical magic, epic kingdoms, and grand quests would start in the freezing, monster-filled White Tundra. After battling snow and fierce beasts, he reaches the wider world, only to find everyone is baffled by such a polite barbarian who asks too many questions and sends foes flying like ragdolls. Ketal just wants the adventure he's always wished for. But can a world that expects a brute handle a barbarian who refuses to be one?

(Source: Tapas)

Mysterious black circles have started appearing all over the world, and whoever falls in doesn't come back out. Then one day, a black circle swallows an entire school and everyone in it, turning it into a twisted maze of nightmares. Will Doyun and his classmates find a way out?

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: คำปรึกษาจากฆาตกร

description:
Elementary school teacher Gi-Jeong Go has lost almost everything: her parents when she was a child, her freedom when she had to support her shut-in younger brother, and now her very dignity as the class bully among her students and his mother threaten to turn her life into a living hell. Upon meeting the mild-mannered yet inscrutable lawyer In-Seop Oh, Gi-Jeong begins to find her life changing, though little does she know that wherever In-Seop goes, death follows…

(Source: WEBTOON) 

*Note: Includes three side stories.*

titles.title: เพียงสันติ

description:
Ju In-Cheol had it all...sharp suits, political connections, and a rising career as the trusted aide to Assemblywoman Lee Myeong-Seon, a ministerial candidate destined for power. But politics is a knife's edge, and one wrong move can send even the best men tumbling. 

When In-Cheol loses footing in the ruthless hierarchy of the office, he's handed a near-impossible task: resolve the explosive redevelopment dispute in Songmun City's Jungang District. Failure means exile. He's ready to do whatever it takes – until he meets An Pyeong-Hwa, the quiet gym owner next door and the key to the problem. Pyeong-Hwa's price for cooperation? 

*"Hit me. That's all I want."* 

Behind that strange request lies something darker than bruises. And as In-Cheol sinks deeper into the deal, he realizes every favor, every blow, is pulling him into a world where politics and pleasure share the same shadow. 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok must fight to protect Mount Hua and fulfill his friend's dying wish.

(Source: WEBTOON)

ようこそ、ローズの屋敷へ

Sick and tired of her mother's ruinous debts, Richelle accepts a post as tutor to the illustrious Otis family. But upon finding a letter with strict, eerie rules on how to survive within the manor of roses, Richelle senses that something sinister is lurking. Now, she must pay the price for her choice.

(Source: Manta)

description:
Set against the backdrop of a wintry Seoul, Winter Breeze tells a story of second chances, hope, and the unexpected warmth that can bloom even in the coldest seasons. Two years after their fleeting encounter at Seoul Station, Hae-Na is reunited with Do-Hwa at a newly opened photo studio tucked away in her quiet neighborhood, and finds herself drawn to the mysterious photographer she hasn’t been able to forget. Is their reunion merely coincidence, or is it the beginning of something meant to be?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ever read one of those webtoons where an obnoxious male protagonist transmigrates into his favorite game, uses his knowledge of the plot to become ridiculously overpowered, and somehow gathers a harem along the way? Now, imagine reincarnating into that story! That's what happens to Nahyeon, but unlike the freewheeling teenager of a hero, she has no interest in becoming the main character. After all, it's way easier to stick right at his side and benefit from his grand plan! Or so she thought...

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: The Hounds of Sisyphus～救いの先にあるもの～

description:
The dead no longer stay dead. They rise—not as monsters, but as aimless wanderers—plunging the world into chaos. Hope of immortality fades as disasters push humanity to the brink of extinction. Unfortunately, word gets around… all the way to Jeong Tae-Oh, a superstitious mob boss who actually believes in that stuff. When Tae-Oh shows up demanding help, Ji-Won pretends to take the job—then immediately tries to run. Too bad he gets caught. 

He wakes up in a sketchy motel, staring death in the face. Thinking fast, Ji-Won blurts out: "Y-you need me as a talisman! To stay alive, we have to… sleep together!"

He’s sure a tough guy like Tae-Oh would bolt at the thought. Instead, Tae-Oh just shrugs.

 *"You should’ve said so earlier. Is once enough or do we need more?"*

Ji Min-Yeong, the ex-lover who terrified him, chased him, and yet was the one he loved more deeply than anyone else, appears without warning. Standing before him with the same chilling certainty as in the past, Min-Yeong whispers the words Jeong-Cheol fears most:

description:
Sang-Nam lives by one unshakable dating philosophy: “before you commit to it, you must hit it.” If the chemistry isn’t right, he won’t even consider a relationship. The problem is, finding someone who actually meets his standards is harder than it sounds. That’s when he notices Da-Ol, a potential hottie with a not-so-sexy body. Sang-Nam casually suggests that he might consider dating Da-Ol if he can “fix” him to suit his tastes, and a nervous but determined Da-Ol agrees. What Sang-Nam doesn’t know is that Da-Ol has a secret preference of his own…and one he definitely hasn’t told anyone yet.

For weeks, a mysterious man has been setting Gyeol’s dreams on fire. By day, Gyeol lives a quiet life as a construction worker. But after locking eyes with a stranger at a job site, his nights are consumed by vivid, erotic dreams that leave him shaken - and wanting more. When he unexpectedly runs into the man again, reality begins to feel just as charged as his fantasies. The stranger introduces himself as Ye-Sung: handsome, magnetic, and impossible to read. His smile is too perfect, his gaze to knowing. He crosses lines without hesitation, drawing Gyeol into a game with no clear rules. As tension smolders between them, Gyeol finds himself spiraling deeper into Ye-Sung’s world, unable to tell where desire ends and danger begins. But play with fire too long, and one is bound to get burned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

On the other hand, Yae-Joon is mild-mannered and polite, and he loathes people like Yeong-Han. Unfortunately, they have to act as a couple for a college course that assigns pairs to recreate a dating relationship. Yeong-Han is displeased, and Yae-Joon even more so. As the two clash and bicker, they slowly wear down each other’s walls to discover their more vulnerable sides. Will this pretend relationship eventually turn into something more genuine?

After years in the criminal underworld, Dao Tongda faces death with nothing to show for his life except a handful of coins. But the heavens grant him an impossible miracle when he wakes up in the body of his 18-year-old self. Reuniting with old friends at the Guanghua Road Fixer Agency, he sets out to claim the power and wealth that once escaped him. But in a world ruled by blood and betrayal, can Tongda rewrite his fate and claim the throne of the night? Or is history doomed to repeat itself?

“There are plenty of fish in the sea,” or so they say. Easier said than done for Gahi Kim, whose crush is rising K-drama star Yubin Choi. Despite going to the same university as Yubin, Gahi can only daydream and grumble to her bestie and roommate Sara, as there’s never any sign of her crush on campus. But then, while having drinks at a nearby pub, Gahi meets a boy who’s the spitting image of Yubin. Seemingly more outgoing and down-to-earth compared to her idol, this look-alike is just the beginning of Gahi’s campus drama…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seung-Jo and Seo-Hee grew up like family in the quiet town of Haeyoung. That is until 6 years ago, when he told her he likes her — but not as a sister — and then left when she hesitated. Now he’s back, no longer a boy but a grown man. And he’s done holding back.

(Source: Manta)

Once a rising star in the popular band Rookie, Connie suddenly vanished from the spotlight after a fellow member stole one of his songs. He quit the band without explanation and disappeared from the public eye. Five years later, after constant persuasion from his longtime fan Louie, Connie reluctantly joins a band at his college called Dead Core, and instantly becomes the talk of campus. But things get complicated when his mysterious roommate Mika, who seems oddly familiar, begins inserting himself into Connie’s life. From day one, Mika insists they’d make the perfect graduation project partners…and he’s not taking no for an answer.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jun-Su, a public health doctor serving his mandatory term at Songhwa Prison, thought his assignment would be dull, routine checkups, a few minor injuries, nothing more. But on his seventh day, the world literally collapses. A mysterious nationwide sinkhole disaster swallows cities whole, cutting the prison off from the outside world. Now trapped inside a fortress filled with men more terrifying than demons, Jun-Su has only one thought: 

*“I have to get out of here.”*

Clutching a stolen keycard, his only ticket to freedom, he makes a break for it. But before he can escape, he runs into the infamous Lee brothers, Tae-Hyeong and Tae-Mu, cold-blooded criminals whose names alone strike fear even among inmates.

 *“What a feast. Lick it clean.”*

With monsters above and monsters within, Jun-Su’s fight for survival turns into a chilling game of instinct, trust, and the brutal will to live.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Le garçon aux perles : Ignite the Dawn

description:
Baek Seung-Hyun has lived in the shadows his whole life, nothing more than the deadly right hand of yakuza boss Shin Jae-Il. But now, Jae-Il is married. And Seung-Hyun, for the first time in years, is left behind. Drifting through empty streets on the night after the wedding, Seung-Hyun crosses paths with Yuta, a delicate ghost from his time in Japan. But what should have been a quiet reunion over a drink turns sharp fast. Yuta’s sweetness curdles, his words cut deep, and before Seung-Hyun can make sense of it everything begins to burn. Uninvited and unrelenting, Yuta storms into his life, dragging with him the weight of the past and something far more dangerous. Seung-Hyun begins to fear that dawn, when it comes, won’t bring light. Only fire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Despite his carefully curated life, everything goes wrong when a single mistake exposes his identity to Yu Min-Hyeok, a straight-laced developer who, to Yeon-Seo’s horror, is completely immune to his magic. Determined to protect his peaceful “human” life, Yeon-Seo comes up with a questionable plan to charm his way into Min-Hyeok and his younger sister’s life regardless, magic be damned!

Convinced that she’s not ready for a relationship, she tells Seolu she’s not looking to date anyone, though her racing heart suggests otherwise. Unfazed, Seolu suggests they just be “good friends” instead. Between his teasing charm and her own conflicted feelings, Nayun soon finds that staying just friends might be harder than she thought.

Je-Hyun, a beta researcher studying Alpha-Omega gene replication, is given a secret mission: lie low for a while and act as guardian for AP1, a dominant Alpha test subject. Moved by the experiment’s innocent eyes, he grows attached to the young subject and names him “Ian.” But the very next day, Jae-Hyun wakes up to find a towering man waiting for him…a man who turns out to be none other than Ian himself, now suddenly fully grown and overwhelming in stature. As the black sheep of the royal family, Lise had been exiled to the countryside at a young age. While she found her own humble happiness with her lover, Destad, her quiet life came to an ugly end when she witnessed his death. She resigns herself to a wretched fate, only to discover that the tyrannical emperor is none other than her long-lost lover. Is this miracle the start of a better life? Or is it the beginning of yet more despair?

Song Ye-eun is a bright and cheerful junior associate on the legal team at LX Pharmaceuticals, hiding a secret that has kept her from ever having a real relationship. When her colleague, the charming company lawyer Jeong Jaemin, accidentally discovers her most private insecurity, Ye-eun braces herself for humiliation. 

But instead of mocking her, Jaemin, who has always seemed like the perfect gentleman, makes an unexpected offer to help “fix” it. What starts as an awkward, impulsive promise quickly turns into something neither of them can control. Beneath Jaemin’s polite smile is a possessive, determined man who’s willing to tear down every wall Ye-eun puts up to win her heart and claim her completely. 

This sizzling office romance follows two people as lust becomes love, secrets turn into confessions, and a woman learns to trust a man’s gentle hands and unwavering devotion.

But after a threat to his village forces Leon to unleash the violent nature he had been suppressing, his existence becomes known to the world... With relentless hunters now on his tail, Leon must face his true nature and fight for his life against a world that demands his death.

As he moves forward, hoping to return to the friendship they once had, he begins to question whether that is truly what he wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After 20 years as a beta, Haon Jung is told that he's actually an omega with unpredictable heats. After suddenly going into heat at work, he wakes up in the home of a rich alpha. Now the alpha wants Haon to live with him, claiming he won't ask for anything, even sex. Can Haon trust this alpha?

(Source: Manta)

Every night, Jae-Hyuk is visited by an uninvited stranger who leaves him drained in more ways than one. The intruder is Mor, an incubus desperate to survive yet terrible at gathering the energy he needs. What started as nightly harassment ends in an unexpected reversal when Mor is trapped in a binding contract with Jae-Hyuk. One longs for freedom, the other wants a normal life, but their unwanted pact begins pulling their hearts in directions neither expected. With desire blurring every line between them, can they face their tangled feelings and uncover the truth behind their growing attachment?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 吉夢〜夢だったはずなのに！〜

description:
Ho-Jin has long harbored a deep affection for Gil-Tae, the kind neighbor who has looked after him since childhood. Unable to confess his true feelings, Ho-Jin’s clumsy one-sided love remains a secret, until one night he finds himself masturbating over a drunken, sleeping Gil-Tae. Despite the significant age gap, what began as a hidden desire is about to cross a line from which there is no turning back, forever changing the innocent bond they once shared. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: I Just Got on the Wrong Bus on My Way to Work
Tôi Lên Nhầm Xe Buýt Trên Đường Đi Làm

description:
Kim Ju-ah just wanted to get to work on time, but one wrong turn onto her favorite baseball team's bus leaves her trapped. The "Home Team" is muscular, hungry, and has zero boundaries. Before Ju-ah can even apologize, she’s pinned down by the very athletes she cheers for, forced to listen to their filthy promises to ruin her for any other man. In the back of the bus, Ju-ah is about to find out exactly how much "stamina" professional ballplayers really have.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Psyche, an imprisoned royal, emerges after years in a tower to find his kingdom destroyed by rebellion and his family’s rule condemned as cruel and corrupt. Grieving his brother Michele, Psyche is seized by the Liberation Army that is led by Anteros, who proposes marriage to exploit an oracle and “destroy the kingdom” completely. Forced into this dangerous marriage, Psyche hides his hatred and plots revenge… But soon he discovers that perhaps his resentment is aimed towards the wrong man.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Having been given a second chance at life, Jin-U begins to take revenge on the women who deceived him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Yeoreum is just a normal high school girl determined to find a cute boyfriend. But everything changes when she stumbles across a constellation shard and transforms into one of the Quprids -- warriors with magical powers. How is she supposed to date Gowon, the hottest boy at school, on top of protecting the galaxy? And why does her childhood friend Doyun seem to know more about the shards than he should? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

(Source: Toomics)

In a world of brutal politics and deadly curses, one woman's touch is the ultimate solution. When the reader wakes up as Lianna, a villainess in a fantasy novel, she discovers that she’s the only person who can touch the tyrannical Emperor Enoch without activating his fatal ice curse. As his only cure, she must heal him while surviving the imperial court and the schemes of her cruel family. But as she peels back the layers of Enoch’s cold facade, she finds a lonely man, and soon their roles as the cursed and the cure blossom into a world-altering romance.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Burned out from work, Yeon-Seul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. But as rescue brings an end to their rendezvous, Yeon-Seul reluctantly resigns herself to the end of her castaway romance–except her island husband doesn’t want to, their love story far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett’s desperate attempts at love fail… until one day, Jian Han awakens in Olivia’s body. She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretly watches from afar. Will old flames be rekindled in this tale riddled with regret and revenge? Or will new love bloom?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kwon Tae-Shin is a man worn thin by indulgence. A VIP at the exclusive members-only club Zeus, he buys fleeting nights with ease, yet never repeats the same encounter twice, forever chasing something that can cut through his suffocating boredom. Lee Won-Woo, a low-level club employee and the sole provider for his family, never expects to cross Tae-Shin’s path until he is assigned to drive him home one night. On a whim, Tae-shin makes him an offer that changes everything, proposing to buy a night with him instead. Stunned but tempted by the staggering amount of money, Won-Woo accepts, only to emerge from the experience shaken and regretful. He tries to avoid Tae-shin afterward, hoping to put it all behind him. But Tae-Shin is no longer bored. 

Fixated on the one man who managed to leave a mark on him, he begins to pursue Won-Woo with unsettling persistence, turning a single reckless decision into a dangerous and irresistible entanglement.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the hidden slums of Hong Kong, two rival powers dominate the underworld: The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate. Their relentless territorial clashes plunge the city into chaos.

Song Ran, the underboss of The Grove Syndicate, is captured by members of The Lotus Syndicate but escapes, only to collapse in front of a modest flower shop. There he encounters Ja Woon-Young, the shop’s refined and gentle-looking owner whose presence feels strikingly out of place amid the shadows of the slums. 

What begins as a chance encounter soon grows into a dangerous entanglement. As the war between The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate escalates beyond control, Song Ran becomes haunted by vivid, feverish dreams of fierce intimacy with Woonyoung. Drawn to him yet disturbed by the menace behind his beauty, he finds himself unable to resist. 

Beneath Woon-Young’s graceful smile lies a chilling gaze that conceals his true nature. Caught between desire and suspicion, Song Ran must uncover the secret of the mysterious florist before it consumes him entirely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Born into the prominent Lee family, Yeon has always enjoyed a privileged and comfortable life. However, his achievements and competence pale in comparison to his older adopted brother, Kangwoo. This disparity fuels Yeon's constant, barbed mockery toward him. While Kangwoo usually endures the insults in silence, Yeon finally pushes him too far with a particularly offensive remark. When Kangwoo unexpectedly extends an invitation to his bedroom, Yeon's sheer arrogance compels him to accept. What Yeon doesn't realize is that his big brother is about to deliver a very intense and unforgettable lesson.

Born with monstrous strength, Macaron Spartan dreams of living as a proper noble lady, but her father insists she follow the warrior fate of House Spartan. Thanks to the unexpected help of a mysterious boy named Ganache, she briefly enters high society and tastes the life she longs for. However, that fragile dream fades as a dark plague spreads across the land, forcing her to wield the strength she wished to cast aside. Can Macaron save the world and still claim the gentle life she desires?

(Source: Tapas)

To the rest of the world, Ju Ha-Ram is the picture of innocence and grace, yet his nights tell a different story. From the vantage point of a stalker, Ha-Ram's modest reputation is a curated lie as he brings a revolving door of men back to his bed. Lost in a world of feverish fantasies, the observer has spent months imagining being the one selected for the night. The line between reality and obsession finally blurs when Ha-Ram makes his move, inviting his shadow into the very home he has been haunting for a year.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Yeo Chae-Woon, the top student in his department, constantly draws attention for his exceptional grades and striking looks. Unfortunately for him, that attention is nothing but a nuisance. When the new semester begins, an unknown stalker starts following him, turning his once-quiet campus life into a constant source of anxiety. Searching for a way out, Chae-Woon comes up with an unexpected idea. He approaches Bae Joo-Han, a classmate from the same department who has been persistently flirting with him, and makes a proposal. For a limited time, they will pretend to be lovers.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Raised in poverty, Kim Woo-Joon has done every kind of job imaginable just to survive. When he rushes back to his rural hometown after hearing about his mother’s car accident, he is crushed by the impossible weight of hospital bills and daily expenses. Desperate, Woo-Joon stumbles into an interview at a luxurious hotel hidden deep in the countryside, a place that caters to the ultra rich and keeps its most exclusive guests in sealed off VIP rooms. There, he meets the enigmatic owner, Kang Ra-Han, a man whose calm smile hides dangerous intentions. Instead of an ordinary job offer, Ra-Han presents Woo-Joon with a startling contract, one that blurs the line between employment and something far more intimate.

With his mother’s life on the line and no other options left, Woo-Joon must decide how much of himself he is willing to give up in exchange for survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 常連さんのハプニング

description:
As part of his pre-graduation internship, culinary student Lee Eun-Seong finds himself working at a sushi restaurant, where one familiar face shows up day after day. But when Eun-Seong accidentally stumbles upon his regular’s secret, things take an unexpected turn. Jeon Ho-Yeong is determined to keep it hidden, while Eun-Seong can’t decide whether he’s annoyed… or oddly drawn in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: ラビットホール〜この関係は底なし沼〜

description:
One drunken night, I thought I finally slept with Ko Woon-Ha, the person I’ve quietly loved for years. At least… that’s what I believed.

 *“Was it really you? Please tell me it wasn’t…”

“If not me, then who were you expecting?”*

Turns out, it wasn’t Woon-Ha at all! It was his younger brother, Ko San. Ko San, the walking disaster. The charming troublemaker. The human hurricane who makes me want to strangle him every time he smirks. The more I try to escape his orbit, the more tangled up I get... like he’s pulling me into his chaos without even trying. Was that night really just an accident? Or is Ko San deliberately keeping me within arm’s reach? One thing’s for sure. Whatever this is, it’s not going to be simple…and I can’t even look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The day of Hae-Seo's interview spirals into disaster—soaked in coffee, harassed, his ex on the panel, and some sleazy, too. He only wanted a fresh start, but instead, he collides with Gong-Woo. Marked by an Alpha before he can settle in, he now has to decide if he'll spend the night with Gong-Woo to undo the mark!

(Source: Manta)

Jun-Seok just started working after his military service. When he visited his uncle's funeral, he met his aunt, Hui-Ae, who he lived with when he was a kid. When he hugged her with his childhood memories in his mind, the scent of each other stimulated their nerves.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

description:
Seol Ha-Eun has always been puzzled by her long-time childhood friend, Yun Do-Jun. Despite his quiet, introverted nature and somewhat gloomy aura, Do-Jun is far from unattractive, he possesses a solid physique and a face that should easily draw romantic interest. Yet, strangely, he has remained perpetually single. Driven by a mix of genuine concern and relentless curiosity, Ha-Eun finally corners him for the truth, only to be met with a shocking confession. It turns out Do-Jun suffers from a debilitating secret: whenever he attempts to get intimate with a woman, he simply cannot perform. 

Stunned to discover her best friend is a "broken man," Ha-Eun impulsively resolves to take matters into her own hands to "cure" his dysfunction. However, what began as a clinical, hands-on lesson soon spirals into an unpredictable, heated entanglement. As the boundaries of their friendship blur, Ha-Eun finds herself whispering a daring proposal: "Yun Do-Jun... would it be okay if I’m the one to take your virginity?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Every rose has its thorn – even one so fair and bright as Karen Shanaire, a star ballerina in the Empire of Gloretta. Karen, who is secretly a spy for the enemy state of Qustia, must extract valuable intelligence from her latest target, Glorettan war hero and key arms manufacturer Duke Arcturus Kloen. Arcturus begins a relationship of convenience with Karen to ward off scandal, unaware that her intentions are anything but benign. Thus begins the deadliest dance of all: a ballet of love, death, and war.

(Source: WEBTOON)

River Marcel Rolland, a nude model, reveres world-renowned artist Daniel Decker, and secretly harbors a deep, burning desire for him. Through secretive means, River secures a coveted spot as the model for Daniel’s upcoming exhibition, "Le désir." As the sessions begin, River wraps his longing in the language of art, offering not just his body, but something far more vulnerable.

Soaked from the rain, Joo-ahn steps into a stranger's penthouse and enters a world of seduction, secrets, and a contract sealed with desire. He needs money, but what he gets is a man who wants far more than just his time.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

The Dawson Group changed the world with their line of pheromone-regulating medications. The long line of alphas in the Dawson family has never failed to uphold that legacy—until now. Henry, the eldest son and successor, has a secret that could ruin his family’s reputation and bring down the company if it were ever to get out. He’s a beta, borrowing the alpha pheromones of his adopted brother, Raz. With so much at stake, will he be able to accept his illicit desires to keep this arrangement?

(Source: Tapas)

On a devastated Earth, the remnants of humanity dwell within the suffocating depths of underground bunkers, desperately preparing for a mass migration to a parallel universe. Su-Bin, a dedicated warp researcher, finds his only solace in his lover, Ki-Hyeok. Upon returning from a perilous surface expedition, Ki-Hyeok presents him with an impossible gift: a living, blooming violet. "It’s a miracle, Su-Bin! The Earth might finally be breathing again!" he exclaims, his eyes shining with newfound hope. It is Ki-Hyeok’s vibrant stories of the outside world that sustain Su-Bin’s spirit in the dim, gray halls of the bunker; for Su-Bin, this man is his solitary light and his only source of true happiness in a dying world. 

However, his fragile peace is shattered when Ki-Hyeok’s fellow soldiers arrive at the laboratory with grim expressions. They deliver a bolt from the blue—news so devastating it threatens to unravel everything Su-Bin believed about their future and his lover's survival.

Hee-seo was on the fast track to success - until her luck took a sudden nosedive. Her shaman grandmother insists it’s because her yin energy is too strong, and the only cure is to find a man with powerful yang energy to balance it out. Hee-seo laughs off the superstitious advice…until the night she meets Gong Tae-su, the charismatic head of the planning team whose energy feels almost dangerously magnetic. One unexpected encounter later, her world starts to spin out of control - along with her heart. Maybe Grandma was right, after all…

After years of grueling study and a job that left her scarred by endless complaints, Iseo retreats to Apricot Hill for peace. There, she reunites with her first love, Hyuk — changed yet familiar. Amid blossoms and quiet hills, could her weary heart find healing and love again?

When nobleman Lee Jung gets kicked out for defying his father's orders, he wanders until he meets the orphan Kwon Chan-Soo. Bewitched by Chan-Soo's resemblance to his first love, Jung finds himself drawn into Chan-Soo's world. But there's more to this orphan than meets the eye, and Jung is intrigued by the mysteries of it all. Will Jung figure out what he truly wants from life, or will Chan-Soo's many secrets trap him in a situation he can't escape from?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sian Lee is fated to die in May, the same month her family was massacred. As the curse draws near, a dangerous man named Gon Tae offers to save her. "Say it," he whispers. "Tell me you want to live." In his obsession, all he asks in return is a promise to share life and death with him.

Until one night, mid–happy time, a glowing portal appears, and out pops a strange man...with his “wand” still inside her. Turns out, Shin-Ah’s favorite toy was magically linked to Kai McGreen, a cocky sorcerer from another world who’s very familiar with the sensation. Now stuck in a fantasy realm with a possessive (and ridiculously attractive) magician who refuses to let her go, shy Shin-Ah is in for a wild, magical ride.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After leaving behind his past as a failed idol from Meteor Boys, Seok-Wu returns to university hoping for a fresh start. Unfortunately, his timing could not be worse…because rising star Yeo-Wun, a rookie actor with a glittering career, also reenrolls. Seok-Wu is used to the contrast in how people treat them, but when Yeo-Wun starts provoking him in ways that feel far too deliberate, irritation turns into wounded pride. Just how far does Yeo-Wun plan to trample on Seok-Wu’s dignity - and why does it feel so personal?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Plagued with splitting headaches, Ji-Min finds a doctor who diagnoses him with terrible news: he will die in three days unless he consumes someone else’s load. Ji-Min dismisses this as a quack doctor’s perverted scheme… until he wakes up to a mysterious screen counting down to his death. Seeing that the screen also states the same cure as the doctor did, Ji-Min decides to swallow the truth and the cure. Thus begins a series of steamy encounters that will save and change Ji-Min’s life entirely.

description:
For struggling idol Hana, a late-night variety show invitation feels like a golden opportunity. Sure, the program is infamous for its over-the-top content, but exposure is exposure... Right? With cameras and staff all around, what’s the worst that could happen? The answer comes fast and shocking. The hosts and fellow guests clearly didn’t get the memo about “professional boundaries.” Suddenly, the games and skits spiral into outrageous territory, the kind of risqué chaos no public broadcast should ever attempt. Hana can only stare in disbelief as the so-called “entertainment” blurs every line between performance and scandal. Is this still a variety show or some twisted after-hours experiment? And most importantly, are the cameras really rolling right now?!Between shock, embarrassment, and unintended hilarity, Hana is caught in the most unpredictable “broadcast” of her life. One thing’s certain: this is late-night TV like no one ever imagined.

(Source: Lezhin US)

To Yun-Ho’s shock, the stranger turns out to be Kwon Wu-Hyeok, his first love from fourteen years ago. Before he knows it, Yun-Ho finds himself working at what might be the best job imaginable, spending all day with Wu-Hyeok. When Hester, manager at Collateral, is left in charge after the owner's sudden disappearance, she learns the bar is a spy hangout and every patron is after intel on a mysterious fugitive named Jackal. Problem is, Hester's now forced to bluff her way through as dangerously suave spies flirt in for secrets she doesn't have — and her life's on the line.

The war around the Curtains at the center of the world came to a close. But war was not the only thing left after the Curtains fell. Those who pursue the Curtains, those who seek to raise them, those who wield special powers, living weapons of war, those who disturb the peace, those who bring hope, those who face the lives they’ve lived, and those who try to revive the corpses in the coffin on their backs. We call them Actors.

With a new divine power to stop time, can Theadora rewrite history?

One day, the two fall victim to the wicked scheme of a creature called Lustmouth and find themselves trapped inside a mysterious labyrinth with a deadly mission to complete. Detective Park Do-Hyeon is a towering force of nature, known for his fiery temper and reckless determination to close cases fast. But his habit of throwing himself into danger without a second thought lands him in the hospital once again. Rushing to his side is fellow detective - and lover - Lee Seung-Woo, Do-Hyeon’s complete opposite in both temperament and approach. Exhausted from watching Do-Hyeon get hurt time after time, Seung-Woo finally reaches his limit and breaks things off. Can Do-Hyeon win back the heart of the man who’s always been his anchor?

But just as she prepares to accept her arranged engagement, fate takes an unexpected turn. When jealousy flares and hearts collide, Herwyn and Lucia are about to find out they’re not done with each other yet. They say third time’s the charm, but could this final chance be the one that changes everything?

While filming a TV animal program about feral dogs tearing up an apartment complex’s trash area, the crew stumbles upon a mysterious man living among them…who just so happens to be the boss of a gang of loan sharks. With no one able to train the man-beast, he is brought to Lee Ji-Ryong: star dog trainer in a heap of debt. In exchange for bringing their boss back to form, the sharks promise to eliminate all of his debt. Jumping at the opportunity, Ji-Ryong takes it on…only to find out that this wild “canine” companion has both bite and bark alike.

Rigid and blunt college student Kwon Jeong-Ha can’t stand Gwak Hyeon-Wu, a handsome, popular classmate who casually toyed with the senior Jeong-Ha secretly loved. The two clash every time they meet… until Jeong-Ha picks up a mysterious necklace and their relationship flips overnight. Claiming he’s a demon, Hyeon-Wu reveals that all the magic he’d stored in the necklace has been absorbed by Jeong-Ha. To make matters worse, Jeongha will die unless it’s returned. But the only way to transfer the magic back? Physical contact. Forced into an uneasy cohabitation with a demon he despises, Jeong-Ha’s quiet life quickly descends into chaos.

Lionel, raised in a violent and suffocating home, finds his first real affection when he meets Arthur, an immortal merman living in human form within an old castle. But Lionel’s family is obsessed with a legend that promises eternal life through the body of a merman, and they set their sights on Arthur. Not only does he act suspiciously playful around Won-Seo, but he even seduces him on his first day back, triggering Won-Seo's repressed feelings of lust and obsession. Even as their bodies mix, there's a question lingering in the air: What could Joo-Hyeon want with Won-Seo after all these years?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Veteran actor Cha Jae-Hwan has built his career on discipline and perfection. So when a close director friend asks him to star in the historical film Ja-Hwa, he expects a challenge, but not this one. At the first script reading, Jae-Hwan meets his co-star, Shin Seong-Hyeon, a rookie actor with raw potential but zero polish. His delivery is flat, his timing off, and his presence all over the place. For someone like Jae-Hwan, who breathes precision, it’s unbearable. Yet instead of walking away, he finds himself guiding Seong-Hyeon, patiently at first, then with a curiosity he can’t quite name.

“Shin Seong-Hyeon is an invasive species,” the director jokes. “You can’t control him. You just have to let him adapt.” 

But as rehearsals blur into something far more intimate, Jae-Hwan begins to wonder who’s really changing whom…

The performance, it turns out, isn’t just on camera.

The woman I love, the one I’ve cherished above all others, is being taken by another man right before my eyes! My heart should be breaking, and my blood should be boiling with righteous fury at the sight of her in someone else’s arms. But as I watch from the shadows, a chilling realization begins to sink in, freezing the air in my lungs. Something is horribly, inexplicably wrong with this picture. Why does it look like she’s enjoying this? In fact, she seems more than just willing... She looks more captivated and thrilled than she ever was with me! It all begins with a meteor shower. Soon after, reports spread of so-called Immortals. Each time they die, their bodies reset to an earlier point in time, with every wound, scar, and even the smallest scratch gone. Humanity is thrown into chaos, unable to explain the strange phenomenon. Two hundred years later, scientists still haven't been able to uncover the mystery of immortality. The Immortals now live in hiding: hunted, captured, and exploited as test subjects. They are forced to live, unable to die. Then, a rumor begins to spread of a man known only as the Undertaker— the one who can kill the Immortals.

Driven to hopelessness, Vivian ends her life—only to awaken on the day of her wedding to Alex, this time with a burning thirst for revenge.

Though Hae-Young has spent his life avoiding the spotlight due to his past successes, he accepts the job and things seem to go well until he catches Yeo-Woon touching himself. At thirteen, he is entrusted with raising his nephew, Yi Nan-Yeong, a gentle boy with no talent for the sword and no expectations placed upon him. At first, Tae-Rok sees it only as duty. Tae-Rok notices the change and chooses silence, drawing careful lines he refuses to cross. In the end, Nan-Yeong seeks clarity in the only way he can, by testing his feelings with another man. And Tae-Rok sees it.

In a court bound by rules, blood, and reputation, their bond teeters on the edge of ruin, where desire threatens to turn into something neither can undo.

Yet, beneath this veneer of normalcy lies a hidden world of unspoken desires and strictly forbidden emotions. What begins as a mere accident ignites an uncontrollable spark that quickly rages out of hand. The magnetic attraction between them, once a subtle pull, now spirals into a deeper, more intoxicating pursuit of pure pleasure.

As the stakes rise, the characters find themselves sinking further into a treacherous mire of ecstasy from which there is no escape. The path back to their former lives has been utterly severed, leaving them to drown in the very sensations they once feared. He wants something personal, intimate, and far beyond protocol. Twisted feelings that should’ve stayed in the past begin to surface again, fueled by power, obsession, and secrets. Behind Enzo’s calculated arrogance lies a dangerous longing, capturing Ángel in a bond he never agreed to and may not be able to escape.

But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A simple clerk and customer routine becomes a rhythm neither wants to lose. In-Ha’s concern becomes habit, and Jae-On waits for it like breath. Convinced a beta cannot draw an alpha’s eye, he uses a pill that mimics omega traits. Affection grows, but so does the strain of a bond built on pretense.

(Source: Manta)

Dying and desperate for real love, Louis steals Phil—a lover dupe bound for disposal—for one month together. But when Phil starts falling for him, their fake romance becomes dangerously real.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: My Father Became a Public Property!

description:
Park Tae-Won never expected to fall in love with an alpha, let alone one twice divorced with a teenage son. But when tragedy strikes, Tae-Won finds himself alone with that son, Ahn Sang-Woo, a boy he never managed to understand. Then Sang-Woo starts getting closer. Too close. And when Tae-Won unexpectedly presents as an omega, what was once grief and confusion curdles into something far more dangerous. Now entangled in a bond steeped in grief and sin, Tae-Won is consumed by guilt he cannot confess, and a craving he cannot cleanse. Some attachments aren’t born of love... 

They’re worn like a crown of thorns.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a war-torn future, a machine called the E.T.A., or Emotion Transfer Apparatus, is developed to rid soldiers of guilt and PTSD. Once A-Jin gets his hands on an illegal version, he modifies it to amplify the user's pleasure with the dream of selling it to make a fortune. When the military gets wind of his plans and captures him as an adult, A-Jin unexpectedly reunites with his childhood friend, Hyeon, who is now a military officer. Believing A-Jin abandoned him when they were young, Hyeon is hellbent on getting revenge by using the augmented E.T.A. on A-Jin himself...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Erika has endured countless slights at the hands of her mother’s charge, the wealthy daughter of the Blanche home. But when the girl falls ill, Erika’s mother is jailed by her father, the cruel Marquis Blanche. To free her, Erika must play the role of the Marquis’ daughter in a sham marriage with Lord Sebastian Aklief. Sworn to secrecy, Erika must rely on her kind heart and newly awakening powers to help her navigate this new world of intrigue, magic, and mystery to free her mother—and herself!

description:
Do-Hyeon has spent years haunted by a lust-ridden crush on his stepbrother, Yu-Won. Yearning after what he can’t have, Do-Hyeon is growing increasingly desperate and daring with expressing his desires in private. Little does he know that Yu-Won is not only aware of these carnal desires, but also reciprocates them. The truth eventually comes to light after the arrangement of Yu-Won’s blind date with someone else… and Do-Hyeon discovers that while the two of them may not share the same blood, they both share the same obsession towards each other.

(Source: Tappytoon)

description:
Ddeosari Cha, or Plankie, lost her family to an alien attack years ago and is bullied for her unusual name and obsession with aliens. When two mysterious Kudoomians– aliens with pink blood, disguised as humans– appear to capture her, she fights back using a strange power… the ability to control the stars. Outnumbered and outmatched, suddenly a blue alien steps into the fray, offering what might be the chance at friendship she’s been searching for her entire life. Will Plankie finally find the ally she needs?

(Source: WEBTOON)

According to the morning's fortune, Park Mu-Woon was destined for a fated encounter. Instead, the universe delivers Na Yeon-Taek, the childhood tormentor he spent nine years trying to forget. What was supposed to be a "lucky" day quickly turns into a nightmare as the architect of Mu-Woon's past misery resurfaces. Now, forced back into each other's lives, Mu-Woon must confront a complicated history and the lingering shadows of a man he never wanted to see again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

College student Jisu decides to spice up a quiet night alone with a bold new idea, only for everything to go wrong at the worst possible moment. Before she can even begin to enjoy herself, the key to her shiny new handcuffs slips away and disappears beneath the closet. Trapped, flustered, and out of options, Jisu realizes there is only one person who can help her: the handsome man living next door. Swallowing her embarrassment, she heads over in desperation, setting the stage for an unexpectedly intimate encounter that neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Ju-ah entered the work force, she was expecting her days to be hard and long…but much to her surprise (and pleasure), that’s not the only thing! Surrounded by three hot bosses who know what they’re doing both in the office and bedroom, this rookie’s first job is bound to be much more unique than most!

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Dex has a dangerous gift: with a single touch, he can read the memories of others. For the past thirty years, he’s been bound by a lifetime contract with the Hero Association, forced into service to cover up a mysterious incident. Now, the Association makes him an offer - if he can uncover the criminal past of the notorious villain Jin, suspected of recent terrorist attacks, they’ll finally set him free. Determined to return to the people he loves, Dex accepts. But to dig into Jin’s memories, there’s only one way forward: intimate contact that blurs the line between mission and desire. Will Dex succeed in his task? Or is he going after something impossible…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Hae-Gyeong, a rabbit shifter, has spent years pining for the golden boy of the neighborhood, Jae-Hyeon. Everyone loves Jae-Hyeon, but Hae-Gyeong wants to be the only one. One impulsive, drunken night, the lines between them blur when Jae-Hyeon crosses the ultimate boundary, leaving Hae-Gyeong more deeply in love than ever. However, the morning after brings a cold reality: Jae-Hyeon is drawing lines again. Now, Hae-gGeong must see if he can finally break through Jae-Hyun’s walls, or if his true love will remain forever out of reach.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
For her entire life in Joseon, Yun Jini believed there was only one man in the world, the king. As a newly appointed chambermaid guarding the royal bedchamber, she begins to awaken to forbidden desires she has never dared to name. But in a palace where love and freedom are luxuries no court lady can afford, her fate turns even darker. Accused of treason and forced to flee, Jini falls into a pond, sinking fast toward certain death.

*“I don’t want to die like this!”*

Her desperate plea is answered. The mysterious waters carry her not to the afterlife, but across time itself, into 21st-century Korea. Here, in a world bursting with freedom she never imagined, Jini experiences love for the very first time. Emotions long suppressed finally find release, and a woman who once knew only duty and fear begins to discover what it means to live... and to love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

While struggling with hardships in her life, Yu-Na meets mysterious I-Yun at a bar. The night she spent with him was supposed to be a fleeting moment. But fate, or rather I-Yun, had other plans—for his meeting with her was far from a coincidence.

(Source: Manta)

Five years ago, Winston and Yu-Jin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yu-Jin’s was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine… But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Have you ever pretended you were good at sports to impress your crush? Enter high school student Haemin Oh, who desperately wants to catch the attention of Ina Jeong, recently elected president of the school swimming club. Ina is recruiting, and despite barely knowing how to float, Haemin somehow ends up making her think that he’s an expert at the sport. Before long, Haemin has to prove himself in the lane. Sink or swim, it’s time to make a splash!

(Source: WEBTOON)

A long-awaited getaway with childhood friends takes a dangerous turn when Yu Seol-Ah wakes in the dark to a touch she shouldn’t want, only to realize it belongs to Lee Tae-Geon, her best friend’s boyfriend. Caught between sleep and reality, her body reacts before her reason can catch up, blurring lines she’s spent ten years respecting. One forbidden moment is all it takes to threaten their friendship, their trust, and perhaps...to give her everything she's ever wanted.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

titles.title: แฟนคนนี้ ต้องถูกทำลาย

description:
Fresh out of the military, he learns his “innocent” girlfriend’s been playing him all along—and sleeping around, even with his tormentor. With the help of his childhood friend, he plots revenge to expose her true face.

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: Người Thầy Tồi Tệ Ở Làng Đảo

description:
On the remote island of Beomhae, Se-ju has spent years loathing the suffocating traditions of her home. As she becomes entangled with a man harboring a dark secret, the island she once considered a prison becomes the backdrop for a perilous affair. In a place where secrets are buried as deep as the sea, she must decide if he is her ticket to freedom or a beautiful trap.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Manny, a member the Seven Sins gang and a secret informant for the police, loses his partner to a brutal serial killer. Before he can even process the shock, his boss assigns him a new partner - Sean, the one colleague he can’t stand. To make matters worse, his contact at the police asks him to dig into Sean’s past, suspecting he’s hiding something. With no choice but to get close, Manny turns to the method he knows best: seduction.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After getting into college, Brian goes out clubbing to celebrate his acceptance and hooks up with a drop-dead gorgeous girl, unaware that he’ll soon be living in the same house as her.

(Source: Toomics)

When Hyun-Woo’s reckless brother wrecks an expensive car, Hyun-Woo scrambles to find money to clean up the mess. Jae-Yoon, his current boss and once his quiet admirer, steps in and offers to cover the debt for him. A single misunderstanding twists their intentions, pulling the two men into a complicated and unexpected new phase of their relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, Do-Ha appears before Do-Hun, calling him hyung as if they were brothers. But something feels wrong. Do-Hun soon realizes that this visitor is not human at all, but a figure pulled straight from the recurring dreams that have haunted him for years. Since Do-Ha’s arrival, strange and unsettling events begin to twist Do-Hun’s once-normal life. His own parents turn against him, he can never seem to get any rest at night, and the line between dream and waking starts to dissolve. As fear takes hold, Do-Hun grows convinced that the only way to end this nightmare is to kill the thing wearing his brother’s face. But when he finally confronts Do-Ha, the creature only smiles and murmurs, “You can’t get rid of me, hyung. It’s impossible. So let’s stay together forever.”

Now Do-Hun must face a terrifying question: is Do-Ha real—or just the reflection of his own fractured mind?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*“You are under arrest as a suspect in the murder of Han Jong-In.”* 

I just went to see my grandfather, but why? Before the shock could even subside, Seo-Hui found out about her husband and cousin’s affair. 

*“From now on, I’m going to take what I want. Everything, including yours.”* 

Everything felt unreal, and the moment her eyes closed… she was transported back to 10 years in the past!? When Seo-Hui woke up again, she saw a college classroom. As she watched her cousin speaking to her in a hateful manner, Seo-Hui made a resolution.

 *“I won’t let you do whatever you want.”* 

She was going to live a different life. To do that, she had to delete her ex-husband first.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Brilliant in both looks and talent, Ryu Chan-Yeong is an elite violinist admired by everyone around him. For Joo Ha-Jin, he is not just a role model but the person he dreams of standing beside on stage one day. That dream feels painfully distant until Ha-Jin is suddenly given a rare chance to receive private mentoring from Chan-Yeong himself. But fate takes a strange turn when Ha-Jin accidentally overhears something he was never meant to hear. Before he can even process it, Chan-Yeong confronts him with a shocking proposal. For a limited time, they will become intimate partners, and when Chan-Yeong decides it is over, it will end cleanly. In exchange, Ha-Jin will receive the mentorship he has longed for. 

Caught between ambition, desire, and the dangerous pull of the man he admires, Ha-Jin must decide how much he is willing to risk for his dream.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
After losing her father, Yeon-Su struggles to support her sick mother and little sister alone. Desperate for money to save her family, she accepts a life-changing offer to be the surrogate of a handsome rich man named Tae-Gun and his infertile wife.The contract seems simple at first, but Yeon-Su soon realizes she's trapped in an arrangement she’ll regret. By the time she's questioning her morality and self-worth, it's already too late to turn back. As forbidden intimacy blurs the lines, unexpected emotions begin to stir between Yeon-Su and Tae-Gun. But is anything real between them?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Tasked with guarding a demon hunted down by the villagers, Finn begins to doubt the truth he’s been told. Everyone swears the demon is a murderer, yet the demon insists it’s the villagers who are lying. Believed the wrong person could result in eternal damnation, but Finn can't help but be intrigued by the demon's claims...

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Late-stage cancer. 3 months to live. How will retired detective In-Su Kang make the most of it? When seeing the death-row convicts he arrested all escape from a prison van, he finds his answer: finish the job. It’s something he could never do as an officer, but the law didn’t do its duty. The problem is all the escaped convicts are moving far too swiftly for it to be a coincidence. They have someone behind the scenes giving them a helping. And this someone also has In-Su’s daughter in their sights. This series contains strong themes and disturbing imagery.

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
For four years, Karen Prime von Mondreal thought of Erich as nothing but her brilliant disciple. However, all that changed when he turned 19 and suddenly confessed his love! He's persistent, and Karen is starting to waver... The only problem is that she'd been priming Erich to become the next monarch, and she has to leave the kingdom so he can build a solid political standing. Can Karen push Erich away when he's determined to stay by her side? More importantly, does she want to?

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: 白虎の王〜俺の愛しき王よ〜

description:
In the Kingdom of Ha, a land bordered by monster-infested wilds, an ancient law dictates that any Bearer. a male capable of conceiving the White Tiger’s heir, must be crowned King to prevent a seven-year famine. After decades of silence, Il-Oh, a lowly slave, suddenly manifests as a Bearer. Following the omen, the former King abdicates, and the Crown Prince, Jang Woon, is demoted to a mere attendant tasked with serving the new, unwilling sovereign. 

Within the palace, a grim secret lingers: once a Bearer bears an heir at age twenty, he is destined for death. Amidst this chilling tension, Il-Oh finds solace in Jang Woon, offering him his heart. However, as Il-oh turns twenty, the divine White Tiger, Geon-Yoo, descends to claim his prize. While Geon-Yoo seeks only to sire an heir and regain his freedom, Il-Oh faces a tragic fate. Caught between duty, survival, and obsession, where will this twisted trinity lead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eunju is a timid, slightly gloomy twenty-year-old with a secret she can never tell anyone. Whenever she holds hands with a man, her body reacts far more intensely than it should. Her quiet life takes a sharp turn when her sunbae Hyeyeong, a self-proclaimed expert in “adult matters,” discovers Eunju’s secret. From that moment on, Hyeyoung decides to take Eunju under her wing, and the two embark into a wild world neither of them came prepared for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

description:
Born the cherished daughter of a noble family, Won’s life shatters when a sudden tragedy leaves her on the brink of being sold off as a courtesan. To make matters worse, the man behind her family’s downfall is none other than the father of her childhood friend, Wanhyeok. Just as she resigns herself to losing everything, Wanhyeok steps forward…paying the price of her freedom with his own two hands. Torn between a desire for revenge and love, does Won have what it takes to avenge her family’s name?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Since childhood, Pil Hyeonseo has dreamed of a fairy tale ending with a perfect prince, the kind she writes about in her picture books. Now 27 and still an unknown author, she believes she has finally found that happy ending, only for it to shatter when her long time boyfriend cheats on her after seven years together. Heartbroken and disoriented by the betrayal, Hyeonseo finds herself standing at a crossroads between the love she lost and the future she never imagined. Just as she is struggling to pick up the pieces, three very different men step into her life, each offering comfort, passion, and a new kind of possibility. Pulled into fresh, intense relationships that challenge everything she thought she wanted, Hyeonseo begins to question what a “perfect prince” truly means. Is it someone with the right looks, the right personality, and perfect chemistry, or is it someone who sees her for who she really is?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Moments before her execution at the Emperor's hands, Manae Frey makes a plea for their illegitimate daughter to be protected at all costs. But after a desperate pact with a mysterious monster, Manae awakens to find she now inhabits her young daughter’s body. Given a second chance as Lilina, Manae resolves to seize the life her daughter was denied — and prove to the Calvaria Empire that she’s more than just a forgotten child. She will claim her place as a true princess, no matter what it takes!

Cali is on a quest to discover her identity and must travel to see the elf queen of Sorte, who left her at the convent as a baby. After hearing Duke Lycan Warren and his knights are traveling in that direction, she disguises herself as the deadly duke’s fiancée and ends up in a political marriage. Although Cali plans to run away eventually, she finds herself being drawn to Lycan as their hearts and bodies grow closer. Can the unlikely couple forge a true bond despite their secrets and lack of experience in love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

But everything changes when his adoptive alpha brother, Yeong-Won, returns to Korea and declares that he was raised to be Jeong-Won's husband. Soon after, Jeong-Won's obsession with Yeong-Won leads to the pair forming a deep bond that defies their family ties...

Isu Jin’s seemingly ordinary life comes to a violent end when he and his father are suddenly targeted by a powerful conglomerate. He survives. But his father does not. In a world where crime and authority are one and the same, Isu enters the underworld to hunt the truth. His fight is no longer just for revenge… It’s to expose a corrupt empire, no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOON)
