In the sweltering heat of summer, seven office workers lose their way during a company workshop. They stumble upon an old mountain lodge filled with mysterious, unidentified bottles of alcohol. As if bewitched, they drink one glass after another slowly letting their reason slipping away. The boss then discreetly offers us a proposal. The lodge suddenly fills with desire and secrets.

*“Would you like to hear the story of my first experience?”*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

titles.title: テラリウムの住人たち

description:
When Hyeonu moves into Terrarium Apartments, the place seems idyllic—until he witnesses a man plunge from the building across his window. The residents dismiss the victim as a “misfit”, and Hyeonu soon notices their unsettling, scripted routines. Beneath the cheerful facade lies something far darker: a community that demands conformity and punishes defiance. As the walls close in, Hyeonu realizes that once you enter Terrarium, leaving may no longer be an option.

*Source: WEBTOON*

Jeong-Un, born into nobility, hides desires society would never forgive. After his former lover leaves him, he drags Sol-Gae, his family's servant, into a forbidden bond of passion and power. If discovered, they could lose everything. Will they continue or return to the roles society demands of them?

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: My Butler Is Overprotective of Me!

description:
Protected his entire life by his loyal butler, Se-Jin, young heir Lee Han-Eul is discovering the real world for the very first time. As he tastes freedom, friendship, and first love, long-buried secrets begin to resurface. Why does Se-Jin seem to care for him as much as he watches over him? The discovery of a terrible secret about his birth will fundamentally change Han-Eul’s view of the world—and his feelings for his butler.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In his hurried transfer to a rural school, Hyoun meets Seonhong, a bright and cheerful classmate who is everything he is not. As often happens with first love, the two quickly become each other’s whole world. But one day, Seonhong vanishes like smoke, leaving behind nothing but memories of a brilliant love at eighteen. Ten years later, they cross paths again by chance at a blind date arranged for Seonhong. Overwhelmed by the pain of being abandoned, Hyoun greets her not with joy, but with betrayal and vengeance.

*"Have you thought about it? Ten million won for one night."*

Their love is now tangled with resentment and regret. Can something so broken ever be mended into love again?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 人魚伝説〜王室に宿る呪い〜

description:
After a brutal war between humans and merfolk, a dark curse settled deep within the royal bloodline. Plagued by agonizing phantoms, Crown Prince Wook flees to a remote coastal temple, only to be lured over the cliff’s edge by the relentless voices. Against all odds, he survives the fall - only to wake up facing an impossible reality, and a mysterious savior who promises to break the royal curse. Can this stranger truly save him, or is Wook simply diving into a deeper deception?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Joon-Hyuk’s only happiness in life is good food. So when, one day, he loses all taste he begins to wonder just what he has to do to fix things. When his sleazy colleague, Yoon Ji-Hoon slides over one day and tells him he knows what’s going on, Joon-Hyuk finds himself following blindly.

(Source: Lezhin US)

4 friends make a bet on who can complete the risky mission first. Why? Because it's fun!

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: Briefing: The Anchor of the Soul
ลิขิตรักบันดาลใจ

description:
When news anchor Eun-Seong Kang meets the enigmatic Woo-Jin Jeong, an unexpected connection pulls them into each other’s orbit. He’s a man trapped in a life that never ends; she chases meaning in fleeting moments. Their encounter feels less like coincidence — and more like fate.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: สวยต้องสาป

description:
Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Yeppeum Kim falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. Soon, she realizes this beauty isn’t a blessing. It is a curse.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: For XX Use by the Construction Site Ajhussis
สุขสำราญคนงานก่อสร้าง XX

description:
Yu Bom has never cared for sweet boys her age. What stirs her is the fantasy of rugged older men, those with tanned skin, rough hands, and the raw masculinity of a hard life etched into their bodies. The construction site, filled with men who embody everything she craves, becomes the perfect stage for her secret desires. But fantasies have a way of bleeding into reality, and Yu Bom is about to step into a world that blurs the line between imagination and temptation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: ต้นกำเนิดของศัตรู

description:
After her father's treason led to the downfall of her family, Evelyn Ophrose lived in hiding until her childhood friend, Ian Callician, rescued her. While at first she's relieved, Evelyn slowly realizes Ian isn't the sweet boy she once knew, and is now trapped in his cradle of seduction and lies.

(Source: Manta)

After losing his sense of smell, genius perfumer Si-Bon tries to end his life but is saved by Ha-Eoon, the owner of a small antique shop. Planning to stay just 3 months before returning to France, Si-Bon takes a live-in job there and finds himself slowly drawn into Ha-Eoon's world with no escape.

(Source: Manta)

Once saved as a child by a boy who appeared like a flame, Jang Do-Ha reunites with his savior and confesses his love. But Kang Tae-Jun knows the truth. Do-Ha’s feelings are not love. He has returned for one reason only, revenge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Su-Hyeon has a loving boyfriend, Hae-Min, but the passion’s gone cold. Haunted by dreams of being taken rough and without restraint, Su-Hyeon can’t shake the hunger that gnaws at him. Then one night at a bar, he meets a man who embodies everything he’s been craving: sharp eyes, a dangerous smile, and a touch that leaves him trembling. As Su-Hyeon falls deeper into the affair, Hae-Min discovers the truth, and what follows is a story of love, lust, and betrayal—perfectly arranged in threes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: ตำนานดูอ็อกซินี
ตำนานวิญญาณแห่งการแก้แค้น

description:
Born with noble blood but stripped of name and freedom, Shin Hee was sold into servitude and erased from history. Then came the rebellion, a single night of fire and blood that wiped out her entire family. But death was not the end. Reborn as Hwa-Ryeong, a courtesan of the pleasure quarters and no longer fully human, she walks the border between the living and the damned. The past clings to her like a curse, whispering of vengeance and loss. Now, two men stand in her path: Yu-Heon, her former fiancé who still carries the weight of her memory, and Crown Prince Lee Kang, the man who sought to possess her from the start. Between love and obsession, mercy and revenge, Hwa-Ryeong must decide what remains of her humanity, and whose blood must be spilled for her to finally be free.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeon-Woo’s love life has been nothing but a series of runaway men - all thanks to his freaky fetishes. But just when he’s about to give up, along comes Jae-Hyun: a perfect face, silky baritone voice, and fingers that look like they were sculpted by the gods. He’s everything Yeon-Woo’s ever dreamed of…and more. Determined to make Jae-Hyun his own, Yeon-Woo pulls his usual rich-guy schemes; but try as he might, Jae-Hyun remains totally unfazed. One drunken night, however, Jae-Hyun lets the truth slip: this handsome hung hunk hungers for someone who knows who take the lead. A guy who checks all his boxes and wants to be trained? Yeon-Woo’s dream project begins now.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 完璧なる飼育者となりて

description:
After losing his memories and home to a vampire attack, Rick is taken in by a hunter guild and later sent to search for a missing member, only to encounter a mysterious vampire who feels disturbingly familiar. Drawn to the very creature tied to his trauma, Rick finds himself caught between fear, desire, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Even a Wild Man Wants to Love!
mangabaka_title: Even a Wild Man Wants to Love!

titles.title: Even a Wild Man Wants to Love!
I want to love nature too!
Let Me Love a Wild Man Too!

description:
All Jung Hyun-Do wanted was a steady job, but he faced constant rejection. Determined to toughen up, he goes to Gwidu Mountain to improve his stamina, only to wind up hopelessly lost. In the midst of Hyun-Do's despair, a shaggy-haired man suddenly emerges from the shadows and whisks him away! The wild man introduces himself as Woo Jae-Chang, and a wary Hyun-Do knows this might be his only chance to escape. Will Hyun-Do and Jae-Chang make it off the mountain, or will it be their final resting place?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 順調な人生〜消えた過去の君〜

description:
Five years ago, an accident erased Ha Do-Geon’s memories. Even so, his life has remained mostly smooth, calm, and manageable. He believes the past he lost no longer matters. That illusion cracks the night he returns home after a university alumni event. His designated driver, Yang Ha-Il, is a stranger, yet the moment their eyes meet, something deep inside Do-Geon stirs. A gaze that feels unfamiliar but achingly known, an attraction he cannot explain. From that night on, Do-Geon’s carefully balanced life begins to shift. Emotions he does not remember choosing start to resurface, pulling him toward a man who feels tied to a time he was sure was gone forever. Caught between erased memories and revived feelings, Do-Geon is forced to confront the possibility that forgetting did not mean letting go. 

As the past quietly pushes its way back into the present, Do-Geon must face the question he never thought he would ask again, what if the most important part of his life is the one he lost?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Irregular Company Relationships in the Workplace

description:
Eun-Ha likes flirting with Woo-Geon at the office, but she knows their relationship can never be more than that. After all, he’s the heir to the huge conglomerate that owns the company they work for, while she’s nothing but an unwanted, illegitimate child. But when Woo-Geon catches Eun-Ha in an awkward position outside of the office, secrets and misunderstandings lead to Woo-Geon making an offer that is definitely “not safe for work”...

(Source: Tappytoon)

romanized_title: [Day and Night Short Story Collection] Melting Home

titles.title: [Day and Night Short Story Collection] Melting Home

description:
In a world that's been nothing but unfair to them, Yoo Jin and Yegeon have found love with each other. However, love is not without its hardships. One is plagued by addictions to gambling and alcohol, while the other has a crippling fear of abandonment, making their time together anything but boring. Others may not understand their rocky relationship, but they have their own special way of working out their issues. Things may not be perfect, but love conquers all, doesn't it?

(Source: Tapas)

 *Note: Part of RIDI's Natjyeobami Danpyeonseon (낮져밤이 단편선) Collection.*

titles.title: Bi Kịch Cuộc Đời Kim Min-Kyung
The Harsh Life of Kim Minkyung

description:
Dragged into a host bar by chance, Minkyeong meets Sihyeok, a man whose savage charm awakens desires she never felt with her husband. As she becomes addicted to the thrill he offers, she drains her money, her pride, and herself, only for his demands to grow more dangerous with each encounter. But her fall is only beginning, because Sihyeok is merely a tool, and the true owner watching from the shadows intends to claim her completely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seo-Wu survives by selling information, living every day on edge. One day, a suspiciously friendly operative who leads with emotion instead of caution shows up at his door. Yi-Jin is clearly dangerous, probably even from a rival organization. And yet… they talk far too easily. 

Between a high-strung informant and a disarmingly open operative, a risky connection forms... Is this pull part of the mission, or something dangerously real?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Cuentos eróticos de una esposa infiel

description:
Cheating Wife’s Erotic Stories is a captivating collection of tales exploring passion, desire, and human intimacy. Each story delves into forbidden connections and the hidden emotions that ignite where they’re least expected. The collection invites readers into a world of secret fantasies, simmering tension, and temptation, where the line between longing and betrayal becomes dangerously thin.

Ordered by the Emperor himself to wed naval officer Edward, Yelodia is disappointed to find that her fiancé has doubts about the arrangement due to their age gap. Undeterred, she sets out to win his heart—but with imperial intrigue in play, can Yelodia overcome the odds?

(Source: Manta)

Se-Ra has never dated, but her curiosity about sex is boundless. Browsing a dating app one night, she stumbles across a shocking post: “Looking for a mistress who can tame me.” Intrigued, she digs deeper, only to discover that the man behind the post is none other than her university lecturer, Professor Baek. Now, with his secret desire exposed, Se-Ra can’t help but begin her own exploration — into both his private world and her own awakening.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After his wife dies in a plane crash, a widower falls into despair. But when a new neighbor moves in next door—looking eerily like his late wife—his world is shaken. Is it just a coincidence, or could she really be her reincarnation? As they grow closer, the mystery deepens.

(Source: Toomics)

Garam has a secret desire she can’t let anyone discover. She only ignites with pleasure when she’s pushed into submission. When Hasung, her brother’s friend, finds out, he makes a dangerous offer. “Want me to help? Then open your mouth.” From that moment, their secret affair begins. But soon, another younger man, Woojae, her friend’s brother, steps between them. Now trapped between two younger lovers, Garam can’t escape the forbidden triangle that has begun.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the secluded town of Riverwort, Jade and Oje grow up relying on each other as family. But when Jade is suddenly consumed by an uncontrollable rut, he loses control and hurts the person he loves most. Consumed by guilt, Jade chooses to disappear, leaving Oje behind with nothing but unanswered feelings, until news arrives that the ship Jade boarded has sunk, forcing the truth of their bond to surface in the most devastating way.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When I moved to New Village, I never expected to be immediately recruited into the local Women’s Association. Their strange rules and provocative ‘initiations’ pushed my husband to run away… but that’s fine — he’ll regret it soon enough.. And that’s how my story in the Wives’ Club began.

description:
After nine years in a stable relationship, Park Ah-jung is on the verge of marriage, yet quietly restless. Seeking a change in her hairstyle, she visits a new salon and meets Kang Jikdo, a dangerously alluring stylist. 

Behind the ordinary facade lies a private VIP room where his demeanor shifts, and the air turns tense and intimate. There, she is met with a service she never expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

My Stepmom Is My Friend's Mom

Jake returns home from the military to a tense household where his stepmother, Susan, battles emotional distance from her husband. Forbidden desires grow between them through a series of intimate and awkward encounters. Their unresolved tensions threaten to shatter the fragile family dynamic.

description:
They might looks beastly, but inside they're all softies. Step inside this furry campus, and find out what these college animals are up to!

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: ドリーイン・ドリーアウト

description:
A rising young director sets out to cast his next project and becomes fixated on a particular actor who refuses to be easily won over. A bold casting offer turns into an even bolder counterproposal, pulling the two into a delicate negotiation where ambition and attraction collide. As their collaboration moves forward, the line between work and romance begins to blur, setting the stage for a relationship neither of them planned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Kiss the trauma：キス・ザ・トラウマ

description:
Raised under the harsh rule of an abusive father, Ju-ho has spent his life being compared to his perfect stepbrother, Hyeon-Wu. As his father’s cruelty deepens and Hyeon-Wu’s obsessive behavior grows more disturbing, Ju-Ho’s spirit begins to break. Then one day, he meets Su-Hyeok, a kind and gentle man who offers the warmth and comfort Ju-Ho has never known. For the first time, Ju-Ho finds himself relying on someone outside his family, falling into a fragile love that feels almost like salvation. But as he clings to Su-Hyeok, Hyeon-Wu’s fixation only festers. Years later, even as adults, Ju-Ho finds that the grip of his family’s twisted love and his own buried wounds are far from healed, and one lingering kiss may awaken everything he’s tried to forget.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ji-Won’s track record with men is horrible. It’s so bad that she’s nicknamed “the trash collector” amongst her friends. Unfortunately, the newest addition to the collection is Do-Kyung, her boss. Do-Kyung is rich, handsome, and… incredibly difficult in terms of personality. Ji-Won is very aware that her crush on him will lead to no good, and she’s proven correct after they impulsively spend a heated night together. His selfish and manipulative behavior is a glaring red flag, but she can’t help wanting him. However, even Ji-Won has her limits to how much pain her heart can handle…

(Source: Tappytoon)

He's the ultimate alpha male—the face of Korea’s best-selling male supplement, flying off the shelves every second. To Suyeon, he's nothing more than an annoying boss… until she discovers the one secret he never wanted anyone to know. Is the romance between a man who thinks he's perfect and the woman who can't stand him destined to spiral out of control? 

(Source: Manta)

Ever since he was a cub, Ryan has dreamed of adventuring across the world. But now that his parents--the King and Queen of Doong Doong Island--are missing, it falls on Ryan to rule the island as their heir...which means he can never leave. Rule or escape, which will Ryan choose?

[English](https://tapas.io/series/ryan-begins/info), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/174222)

description:
When Seul-Yeong brought a puppy home, she never expected it to be an android — a sex android that looks exactly like her terrifying boss, Manager Seo! Now she's stuck hiding her look-alike manager at home while acting normal at work. But when her boss suddenly leans in for a kiss... chaos and temptation spiral out of control.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: เพียงสัมผัสแผ่วเบา

description:
Han Yoo has a little problem—namely Dami Lee, the daughter of his mentor. Now that she's an adult, Dami has made it her mission to win Han over, even begging him to let her be a teaching assistant at the academy where he works! To make matters worse, his body starts acting strangely whenever she's around...

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: [Pure Love Anthology] A Must-Read Before Marriage

description:
*“Is it big or small? My future husband’s… manhood, I mean.”*

According to the era's most scandalous bestseller, a truly great husband must be blessed with both a stunning face and a grand "package." Seo-Young, a bride-to-be, takes this advice to heart. In a bold move to vet her fiancé, she ends up asking a complete stranger—whom she mistakes for her future brother-in-law—about his brother’s size. When he suggests his own is a fair comparison, he leaves her with a tempting offer: "Meet me at the watermill tonight if you want to see for yourself." Driven by a curiosity she can’t suppress, Seo-Young steps into the shadows of the watermill, stepping into a trap of desire she never saw coming.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.*

Stardust, who initially opposed him, gradually opens her heart, and soon even begins to show signs of obsession toward him...?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kang Min-A's daily life is completely turned upside down by the sudden acquisition of the ability to . Now, what unfolds before her are irreversible events caused by a single moment of choice. In the midst of anger, confusion, and suppressed sense of justice, Min-A begins a new journey, wondering where to use her power. In what direction will her power flow, and what choices will she make?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Dream Boy was a beloved idol group until a scandal ended them. Now Jaeyoung delivers food to survive. A late-night call sends him to a club, where he runs into Seungmin—the man who took his stage name "Happy" and became a star. Then Seungmin drops a proposal: *"You know who I am. Let's collab."* 

(Source: Manta)

Is It Okay to Cry Now?
もう泣いてもいいですか？

description:
Evie Alden wasn't supposed to be here. A girl from the poorhouse, she was admitted to the elite Imperial Gifted Center on a whim—hand-selected by a lonely emperor despite her humble beginnings. Now an outsider, Evie faces ruthless bullying from peers who want her gone. But she has a secret weapon... a genius so undeniable that even the most feared instructors can’t ignore it. As Evie proves she belongs, she unknowingly begins to heal the broken heart of the man who thought he’d lost everything.

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: How to Live as the Vampire Lord

description:
After half a year on the run, the vampire Eugene was ultimately killed, offered up as a sacrifice to boost a holy knight's fame. Just as his life ended in bitter regret, a chance to return came to him.

*“I will never die like that again. If I’ve truly returned to the past, then I'll never regret anything a second time... no matter what it may take."*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
The very last moment before the novel was about the end... The strongest villain met a pitiful fate. But that wasn't the end.

*"So, this is how I die."*

I, who was once the author, woke up as the fox-eyed villian who was never once understood. A fallen family. A life thrown away for revenge. A future sealed in tragedy. I'm going to rewrite it all. This villain's end... will be reversed.

To reclaim the world, humanity continues its pioneering efforts, and a boy named Kay aspires to join the expeditionary force. But he’s rejected because he is colorless, lacking any hue. Then one day, through an unexpected incident, Kay gains the color black....

Claiming to be her friend, Hae-Su starts exacting revenge on Eun-Ha’s tormentors. However, his violent methods concern Eun-Ha, and she begins searching for answers to uncover the past and his true identity.

As a child, Shin Woo-Jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-Jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans.

Thus, Blow enters Helios as a student under the name "Rood Krisch" while hiding his identity... Will Blow be able to successfully complete the request amidst the whirlwind of unexpected events?

Yu Jitae is a Regressor wielding limitless power—and he still isn't strong enough to prevent the end of the world. But this time, in yet another timeline, Yu decides to try something different: maybe he can nurture the destruction out of these dragons as their guardian!

Fueled by vengeance, he begins the climb again, but without money or his former abilities, there’s no way he can get his revenge… until he starts streaming. As his stats rise with his view count, Suhyeok turns his revenge into a viral spectacle that no one, not even his killer, will ever see coming.

So, when given a second chance, she resolves to atone for her past by changing her allegiance: This time, she'll serve the crown prince whom she helped expel in her first life. The most glorious name in this land, Gauri. He who protected that name. People call him the Steel Emperor! Go Jin-Cheon, the last general of the fallen Gauri (Goguryeo). At the moment of defeat, he and his elite unit, the "Mukapguima Squad," are cast into another world. It is an unfamiliar land inhabited by various races, including elves, orcs, dwarves, and wizards. If he cannot return, he has no choice but to establish a new Gauri. Go Jin-Cheon raises his flag once again to conquer the continent.

The pitiful Mia, who served as the villainess protagonist's handmaiden, died after being wrongfully accused. That was Chae Mia's past life. Always standing by the villainess's side, passively watching her wicked deeds, running away simply because she was afraid... Deeply disillusioned by her own weakness, Mia hears an unknown voice...

\[If you could go back, would you make different choices?\]

 *'Go back...? Could I really change if I went back...? But... if I don't even try, I'll never change for the rest of my life...!'*

Mia resolved to return to her past life and change her actions. And so, she regressed to the very moment she first met the female protagonist who had tormented her.

While training relentlessly using the knowledge he gained in his modern life, Johann ends up encountering Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Empire’s greatest assassination guild, the Nesos Guild. Forced to live a twisted life of regret and buried secrets, Kai must confront a past that isn’t his and find a way to rewrite a fate never meant to be. Tae-Ju, who consoles himself that this is really the last time, hires a new secretary, Eun-Na, under the pretense of researching a new business, and urges her to accompany him on his dessert cafe tour disguised as work. *Note: Part of Metatoon's Yeongjeong Danpyeonseon (연정 단편선) Collection.*

This high-octane, provocative CG-toon is meticulously crafted for adult audiences seeking an intense, sensory-driven experience. Moving far beyond the boundaries of traditional storytelling, this anthology dives headfirst into the lives of thrill-seekers who have utterly abandoned their moral compasses. The collection features a diverse array of taboo scenarios that explore the darkest corners of human desire and the raw electricity of forbidden encounters. 

From the bittersweet yet dangerously seductive reunion with a long-lost first love to the adrenaline-fueled, illicit risks taken by a subway predator, every chapter is designed to push limits. These are stories of individuals who live for the moment, indulging in deviant escapes that regular society dares not mention. With stunning, high-definition CG visuals that bring every scandalous detail to life, this collection invites you to witness a world of uninhibited passion and absolute deviation. Prepare yourself for an unapologetic descent into the deepest, most exhilarating depths of adult fantasy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a great catastrophe, the world is divided into small tribes. Each tribe possesses mysterious individuals known as "Powerful Ones," who serve as both offensive and defensive forces for the tribe. For a long time, wars and conflicts between the tribes continued, but these Powerful Ones intervened and made a pact not to invade each other, leading to a period of lasting peace. A century later, a small tribe in the north proclaims itself the "Nation of the Herd," establishes a "nation," and begins subjugating other tribes by force. The tribes are colonized, and their children are taken away. These children undergo rigorous education and training to become "Fighters" of the Nation of the Herd, and are then deployed in battles to conquer the colony.

During a battle with the Wild Tribe, they capture Garo, a boy with the potential for destruction, and Garo's mother, a Powerful One, and subdue the Wild Tribe. Mo-Hun, the youngest prince of the Land of the Herd and a warrior at the forefront of the conquest war, leads Garo and the Fighters on their quest to conquer the Island of the Beginning. Encountering storms and stranding, they eventually reach the Island of the Beginning, where they encounter the Prime Tribe. Living among these people, who have a completely different way of thinking and lifestyle, on the peaceful Island of the Beginning, Mo-Hun, the Fighters, and Garo gradually begin to change. 

Meanwhile, the Land of the Herd succeeds in developing Ancient Power (Explosives), and Prince Kaitan heads to the Island of the Beginning with his army, carrying the explosives. Having set foot on the Island of the Beginning, they launch a war of aggression. The "Those Who Remember the History of the Gods (Simbang)" of the Beginning tribe summon "Gwanegitto (God)" and fight back. And Mo-Hun and the Fighters begin a battle to protect the Primordial Island and the Primordial Tribe against their homeland. description:
The moment I blew out the candles on my 7th birthday cake—

I realized I had reincarnated into the world of a novel. And not just as anyone, but as the daughter of the main characters! The problem is…

[The heroine ■ □ dies, and the male leads… cause the world to end?]

So, in the side stories, my mother dies and my fathers cause the apocalypse? Is this for real…?

‘No way. I’ll stop it no matter what!’

I’m a brave seven-year-old now! So, I set out to lead my fathers and twist the original story by any means possible.

“You know what? You and I are destined to fall in love someday.”

I’m busy enough trying to save my mother, so who the heck are you?

After successfully twisting the original plot, I was planning to finally enjoy my youth, but —

“A son-in-law? Sure. I’ll accept anyone, as long as they meet one condition.”
“What condition?”
“They have to fight us and win.”
“Whatever the reason, any guy who lays a hand on my daughter is as good as dead.”

It seems my fathers have no intention of living peacefully.

“That’s easy. Just tell them to come at me all at once.”

Why are you agreeing to that so casually?!

But, as the saying goes, “a monk can’t shave his own head.” Her own love life fails again and again. On top of that, because those hunches come to her anytime and anywhere, people often treat her like a strange person. That is why her first meeting with Eungi was, in short, a complete disaster.

A handsome face, but a personality that doesn’t match.

Eungi, famous as a divorce lawyer, does not believe in love, which he considers nothing more than an empty emotion, after witnessing the unhappy end of his parents’ marriage during his childhood.

Then, while handling a divorce case, Eungi is attacked by a stranger and loses his memory. When he sees Boyoung, who comes to visit him at the hospital, his heart begins to race like crazy.

When his memories suddenly return upon seeing her, Eungi starts looking for her every day, using his memory as an excuse. However, at the same time, he hurls cruel words at her, saying that “once he regains his memory, this heart-pounding feeling will disappear too”...

One day, a handsome man who seems completely out of place in such a setting appears—and he even singles her out by name! “Oishikunare~! Moe moe kyun!” Unfazed by embarrassment, the heroine shouts the chant loudly right in front of the handsome customer. Surprisingly, despite his own shyness, the man follows along with every single word of her cheer. But that night, on her way home, the heroine senses a suspicious presence tailing her. Acting on instinct, she lands a solid punch on her pursuer—only to discover it’s none other than the very same handsome customer who had so passionately echoed her chant earlier!

Source: MU

As a successful courtesan, Hwayoung believes she’s seen every kind of man the world has to offer. That is, until a nameless new servant arrives at the house. Hwayoung can’t help her curiosity about him, and her flirtations seem to turn him into putty in her hands. But pretty soon, Hwayoung will be the one unable to resist the seductions of this not-so-innocent beast. Just who is the one getting tamed here?!

Source: Tapas

We’re officially a married couple! They say marriage is one long, continuous conversation, but every moment feels brand new and surprisingly difficult. Still, we have to keep going, right? Whether we’re communicating through words or our bodies... we’re doing this the right way, aren't we? Explore the steamy, awkward, and heartwarming reality of a couple figuring out what it truly means to be husband and wife.
Source: Lezhin

Taerang and Junhee's 7-year connection started as friends and eventually became a situationship. Now, although Taerang is certain they like each other, there's been zero development in their relationship. Frustrated by Junhee's passive attitude, he proactively attempts a kiss but instantly gets a nosebleed. “Now of all times?!” He hates that his nose bleeds so easily, but Junhee's reaction is unexpected… Taerang lowers his head at what he thought was Junhee’s clear agitation, only to be greeted by Junhee’s massive erection. Thankful that Junhee has a nosebleed fetish, and determined to push forward their relationship, he starts hitting on Junhee every time his nose drips with blood.

Shiloh the orphan thought she found happiness when she was adopted by Duke Defons, even if he only did it because she resembled his late daughter, Claire. But when Claire turns out to be alive and returns eight years later, the Defonses start treating Shiloh coldly and waste no time canceling her adoption. Even worse, they frame her for a murder that she didn't commit! Backed into a corner, the desperate Shiloh accepts the helping hand of her mysterious acquaintance, Caleb, whose intentions aren't entirely pure, either. Can Shiloh clear her name and get revenge on everyone who wronged her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

I Refuse an Ending Where Mom Dies!
I Refuse an Ending Where My Mother Dies!
The Ending Where the Mother Dies Is a Disaster!

description:
The moment I blew out the candles on my 7th birthday cake—

I realized I had reincarnated into the world of a novel. And not just as anyone, but as the daughter of the main characters! The problem is…

[The heroine ■ □ dies, and the male leads… cause the world to end?]

So, in the side stories, my mother dies and my fathers cause the apocalypse? Is this for real…?

‘No way. I’ll stop it no matter what!’

I’m a brave seven-year-old now! So, I set out to lead my fathers and twist the original story by any means possible.

“You know what? You and I are destined to fall in love someday.”

I’m busy enough trying to save my mother, so who the heck are you?

After successfully twisting the original plot, I was planning to finally enjoy my youth, but —

“A son-in-law? Sure. I’ll accept anyone, as long as they meet one condition.”
“What condition?”
“They have to fight us and win.”
“Whatever the reason, any guy who lays a hand on my daughter is as good as dead.”

It seems my fathers have no intention of living peacefully.

“That’s easy. Just tell them to come at me all at once.”

Why are you agreeing to that so casually?!

display_title: To Me, Who Will Shake Tomorrow as Well

titles.title: To Me, Who Will Shake Tomorrow as Well

description:
Despite the abuse she suffered at the hands of her parents and partners, Didi was unable to break free from these relationships due to chronic anxiety and a sense of deprivation. Then one day, she meets the kind and thoughtful Yu-Jin and finally finds the courage to escape her abusive relationships. But just because love has begun doesn’t mean her wounds will disappear. Didi, an anxious person who constantly craves reassurance of love, and Yu-Jin, an avoidant person who gradually distances himself, unable to cope with those feelings. As they grow closer, the two become increasingly unstable. Will they truly be able to love each other? And will Didi be able to save herself and grow? 

A emotional drama that delicately yet sharply portrays the real-life romance between an anxious woman and an avoidant man.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*
Collection of series published under [Dirty Talk Anthology] theme.

Noah Brown has a gift for fighting. Unfortunately, punching things doesn't pay his bills. 
At least, that was the case until he dies and an Eldritch god finds his soul. 
The strange encounter brings him to a new world, summoned by bloody cultists. 
He’s got nothing but the shirt on his back and a strange item of unknown power he isn’t yet sure how to use. 
If he wants to survive, maybe even thrive, perhaps it's time he finally put his gift to good use.

**Official Translations:**   
[English](https://www.webtoons.com/en/action/rise-of-the-devourer/list?title_no=7818)

Everyone assumes Bonnie is a ditsy redhead barely surviving corporate life until a late-night office attack reveals her true nature: sharp, capable, and deadly. Her unexpected display of skill draws the attention of the Fianna, a secret organization that wastes no time recruiting her as an apprentice assassin. To her surprise, Bonnie thrives in this dangerous new world. But one obstacle remains: Ronan Clarke, the Fianna’s top operative, who sees her as a joke and is now forced to rely on her as his partner. Will Bonnie ever be able to prove herself to Ronan?

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Digital](https://www.webtoons.com/en/romance/accidental-assassin/list?title_no=8167), [Print](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/827228/accidental-assassin-vol-1-by-molly-ni-cheileachair)
The story of how Silas and Ezra first met.

titles.title: Murder Drones: The Official Graphic Novel

description:
From the twisted mind of creator Liam Vickers and Glitch Productions comes a heart warming story of “destroy all humans.”

In the far future, a natural disaster has flash-frozen humanity’s remote mining exoplanet, Copper 9. Only now the “worker drones” – built by humanity and eventually outlived by them – have to rebuild society from the frozen ashes... An endeavor complicated by the appearance of “disassembly drones,” vampiric robot counterparts hell-bent on wiping mechanical life from the planet and the unexpected emergence of an unsettling entity known as the "Absolute Solver.”

Who would have thought that Do Haewon, the perfect guy who can charm anyone, actually has such a complicated love story full of drama and betrayal. For some people, the situation between Haewon, Jeha, Taehyun, and Seoyoon might seem like madness filled with lust. But for them, it's like they're playing a game called love. A game filled with lunacy, lust, betrayal, obssession and jealousy that will either lead them to victory or defeat.

(Source: WEBTOON Canvas)

Set in the neon sovereign city state of Elysia, QUIXOTIC RE:SONANCE is a hyper-violent, hyper-sexual dystopian drama inspired by late '80s and early '90s anime, idol culture, the music industry, and above all, the depths of human compassion and cruelty. A story that is brutal as it is gentle and chaotic as it is deliberate. QUIXOTIC RE:SONANCE follows the lives of 3 individuals, Ren, Hoa, and Kei, in a glittering metropolis rotted from the inside out. In a city where dreams are weaponized, their paths collide under lights that conceal more than they reveal. As their lives intertwine, buried secrets surface, rewriting everything they thought they knew. QUIXOTIC is a full sensory experience, a world scored by original music made with the same care as the story itself. One built to move you and stay with you.

_Source: NamiComi_

Experience the whimsical, tragic, and sometimes haunting backstories of the party of misfits who would become the Mighty Nein. Created in collaboration with the cast of Critical Role.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Every year in October, Mexico celebrates the “Day of the Dead” — a day when the dead are allowed to reunite with their families.
But what if not only loved ones returned on that day… but also creatures that should have stayed buried forever?

The grim reaper itself assembles a team of the greatest warriors in world history. Together, these legendary fighters must prevent an army of the undead from overwhelming the world.
The battle against the underworld has begun.
And it starts in Mexico.

*Source: Drawing like a Sir*

description:
A reimagined narrative inspired by Don Quixote. A young boy discovers his passion for knights and chivalry and shares that with the old man who works at his manor. They venture across space and time to experience an adventure of a lifetime.

*Source: Pixiv*

*Note: Finalist in KADOKAWA's Wordless World Manga Contest (2025), "Themed Manga" category.*

In a world where power runs through the bloodlines of the Gaian people, two sisters are torn apart by secrets and betrayal. The elder, marked by strength, hides a truth that could destroy them both. The younger seeks vengeance for a loss she can’t understand. But between them stands Cloe Greyollf, a trusted friend with hidden power and a role that could change everything. As their fates collide, Cloe must decide how far she’ll go to protect the truth and those she loves.

Source: Namicomi

In "Teach me first" Andy and his wife Amber arrive at his parents' ranch, and Andy is stunned by how much his stepsister Mia has changed. She's grown into a woman, full of confidence and experiences Andy never could have imagined. While he can't take his eyes off Mia, Amber finds herself drawn to Jack, the strong, rugged father of the family. ln "Teach me first" everyone becomes one big family, bound together by special ties.

From Manga Classics: I love your Majesty according to my bond; no more nor less. The aging King Lear of Britain has decided to abdicate his throne and divide his realm among his three beloved daughters. The largest share shall go to the one who loves him best - unfortunately, Lear mistakes empty, overblown flattery for true devotion. His error plunges the realm into war and drives Lear to rain-drenched madness. Manga Classics is proud to bring you an unabridged manga adaptation of Shakespeare's beloved tragedy, considered to be one of the greatest works of literature ever written!

Life has been tough since Viola's Dad passed away 3 years ago. After days by days training, she embarks on a mission to explore ruins hoping for a fortune, together with two explorers she hired, Rain and Bleu. 

Little does she know, that this expedition will cause her life to turn inside out. What she hopes for a fortune, goes into a curse instead. A strong curse which could turn her into a demon, a fairytale like in which people already think of as extinct.

(Source: NamiComi)

Anyone can wield unimaginable power - if they crush a fairy scale, that is. Scale Hunters seek out beasts to kill them for their scales, whether that's to use the power themselves or sell it off to the highest bidder. But when slum boy Mote discovers a fairy, he doesn't want to crush it. He wants to save it. 

_Source: Webtoon_

About a Grim Reaper and a mysterious soul that follows him around everywhere. But something about that soul seems painfully, achingly familiar...

- Webtoons

Being a shonen protagonist is a pain! Oryn avoids mobsters, monsters, and mayhem to achieve his true dream: living a completely unexceptional life. Unfortunately, his villain—volatile, dangerous, annoying Zef—can’t seem to let him go. If he can’t change his role, Oryn wonders if he might be able to change his genre instead… and what could be better than romance?
Source: Webtoon

DJ just wants a simple life with his friends, until a chance run-in with a witch named Superfish leaves him accidentally bonded to a powerful witch’s core. Now a walking target for any malicious creature, DJ finds himself under Superfish’s reluctant protection as they search for a cure before it's too late… assuming the two can get along to make it to the other side.
Source: Webtoon

You know what’s worse than breaking up with your girlfriend? Getting stuck on a sadistic alien gameshow with her cat. Join Carl and Princess Donut as they try to survive the end of the world — or just get to the next level of a trap-filled fantasy dungeon.

Althea -- heiress to the Loviatar crime syndicate -- has been playing a cat and mouse game with the duke and head Jupiter agent Damien Reed for years. The phantom thief has stolen art, gems, secrets and gotten away without a trace. But the one thing she can't get away from is her father's control. So she has no choice but to accept when he offers up this impossible bargain: impersonate Damien's fianceé, take down Jupiter from the inside, and kill Damien in exchange for her freedom. All Althea needs to do is not get caught or fall in love with the duke in the process.

(Source: Webtoons)

Murdered on her wedding day, Alena returns as a ghost to kill the mastermind of her assassination: her very own groom. What happens when her target is not only the most powerful man in the kingdom but could also see and touch a ghost? His touch unraveled sensations she was supposed to never feel again. But Alena is determined to fulfill her dying wish and not even the mysterious duke’s allure could stop her from delivering justice with her own two hands.
Source: Webtoon

When Kieran meets his new classmate, Mason Kane, he bristles with an unexplainable disdain. Soon it becomes apparent why: Mason is a werewolf. But when a fight turns into a sudden kiss that neither expects, Kieran's feelings for Mason turn to attraction in an instant. None of it makes sense - vampires and werewolves are supposed to be mortal enemies, so why does Kieran find Mason so irresistible?

(Source: Webtoon)

When Jas jokingly claims he’s dating “Art,” his words spark a school-wide misunderstanding that flips Art’s life upside down. The rumor costs Art his chance to get closer to his crush Julienne, who just so happens to also be Jas’s sister. To make things right, Jas proposes a deal: if they pretend to date, he’ll help Art win over Julienne. As they navigate fake couple activities, unexpected friendships, and school drama, their carefully crafted act becomes more complicated than they ever anticipated.
Source: Webtoon

description:
Princess Amara fakes her own death to escape an unwanted marriage and reinvents herself as Duke Alexander—the perfect suitor to marry Lady Elaine, the woman she truly loves. But Elaine, unaware of the truth, is set to marry Prince Edgars—Amara’s own brother. When the Emperor declares a tournament for Elaine’s hand and the throne, Alexander must outfight rival suitors and win Elaine's trust—all while keeping her true identity a secret.
Source: Webtoon

Ema Nakahara has never killed anyone. She's just a girl trying to make it in the cutthroat music industry, stuck as the forever intern. But when she suddenly finds her first big break as the lead singer of Starfruit, an up-and-coming queer band, it is immediately plagued by misfortune: cancelled gigs, a scummy manager, a dead body—and a lot of secrets to keep. The band doesn't deserve this. Emboldened by her new friendships, Ema will do whatever it takes to protect them and her dream.

Source: Webtoon

In a dangerous world teeming with monsters at every turn, the kingdoms placed their hopes in the System Users, powerful adventurers who grew stronger faster than anyone else. Among them was Novis, one of the most righteous of all. But when a quest goes horribly wrong, Novis’s system becomes infected... and his first new quest is a thirst for blood. The world isn't as simple as Novis once believed. The line between monsters and humans begins to blur, because Novis is no longer just a man. He’s a vampire... a vampire wielding the kingdom’s most powerful system.

(Source: WebToon)

After illegally sneaking outside the city boundaries, Slade becomes unlikely friends with Calico, a boy from the outer slums who the city deems "defective" Can they stay together when the outside world is full of deadly 'haze', and the only safe haven wants them apart?
Source: Webtoon

Primrose Academy is a prestigious school attended by future gods, angels, and familiars. For the Angel of Death, Azrael, there’s only one goal in his final year: to graduate. With the help of his friends—and a pact to make the most of their last year—what could possibly go wrong? Well, aside from someone at school discovering a secret that could get Azrael expelled.
Source: Webtoon

Yejun is a private investigator who specializes in catching cheating partners. Love is the last thing on his mind. But when he's assigned a cupid tasked to find Yejun a soulmate, the two are forced into an uneasy partnership. They don’t get along, but as they work together, they begin to uncover darker truths about each other, and what it really means to fall in love.
Source: Webtoon

A fae’s exile and an artist’s despair ignite a journey of magic, danger, and a love that crosses realms.
Source: Webtoon

Athena is desperate. Why is dating girls so hard? Even though she's doing everything to become the "it" girl- the skincare, the workouts, and even the university she goes to- nothing is working. Where is Athena's love story? Every crush ends in disaster, every date is a flop, and her confidence is running low. But then she meets Levi, the handsome yet mysterious barista. Athena can’t keep her eyes off of her! She knows she can't mess this one up and her friends have just the solution. Athena needs... the Girlfriend Manual.

Derek lives by one creed. Fight, adapt, and rely only on himself. In the years after the System arrived on Earth and warped it into a monster-ridden wasteland, those rules forged him into one of Earth’s most powerful warriors. They let him thrive in the face of the Apocalypse — until the day he broke them. Failed by his teammates and sent through the void into an entirely new world, fate seems to have wanted Derek to start all the way back from the beginning at level 1. It’s a good thing he brought his old System with him.

At first, leveling up seems like the only good thing about the new brutal fantasy world Rob’s suddenly found himself stuck in. Leveling up’s euphoric. Addictive. It almost makes up for the fact that everyone here hates Humans. Until Rob discovers the why behind both: Leveling High, a curse unique to Humans that drives them closer to bloodthirsty madness every time they level up. Can Rob survive and find his way home with his sanity intact? Or will he lose himself chasing the thrill of power?
Source: Tapas

Retired from a decade of brutal war, John Sutton wants nothing more than to disappear into the countryside. But no matter how far he travels, it’s impossible to escape the devastation he’s wreaked on this world. Bandits, suspicious townsfolk, and a secret magic that lurks in the mountains all threaten John’s peace… It’ll take all of his considerable power to keep himself from burning everything to the ground.
Source: Tapas

The story begins with Alex, our protagonist who returns to his hometown
after 6 years of living outside the country.When he was on Elementary School, there was a guy who used to bother him,
because of his delicate appearance,
Back to where he have so many bad memories, isn't something that cheerful him.

*Source: Tapas*

River knew she was a replacement when she agreed to marry the billionaire, Noah De Marco. She'd give birth to his dead lover's children, warm his bed at night, and even raise the babies with him. She would be his only woman but he would never love her. River agreed, secretly hoping… someday he’d change.

Source: Manta Comics

Nina is living on her own for the first time, and between work, classes, and home maintenance, she's determined to make it work. Sure, she's learning as she goes, but how hard could it possibly be?

Source: Webtoon

"There's the scarlet thread of murder running through the colourless skein of life, and our duty is to unravel it, and isolate it, and expose every inch of it." It is 1887 and a man has been murdered in an abandoned house. On his face is an expression of utter horror; in his pocket is a woman's wedding ring. On the wall above him is the word RACHE, written in blood. But whose blood is it? Thus begins the story of one of the world's most famous partnerships.
Source: Udon Entertainment

Legend says the God of the Afterlife gave his heart to one human girl to keep her as his eternal bride. Their love is loyal, their love is forever, and their love is a prison for the eighth reincarnation of Mei Shi. Raised in a secluded shrine to become the perfect bride, Mei Shi refuses to be humanity’s peace offering to the Afterworld any longer, especially after discovering the God of the Afterlife's true cruel nature. To escape being forcefully married off to the terrifying and possessive god once again, Mei Shi will forge her own path under her own name: Mytha. She’s willing to defy the gods, humanity, and fate itself to end this cruel love story. Mytha, more than just a bride, will kill the God of the Afterlife herself.

As brave Jedi Knights fight to protect the Jedi Temple on Banchii in the battle against the Nihil, Jedi Master Yoda must find a way to protect the younglings who call the planet home. But the fearsome Marchion Ro, the Eye of the Nihil, has other plans for the Jedi Master, as he unleashes his most terrifying weapon against the champions of justice yet…
Source: VIZ

On the night of her eighteenth birthday, Faith Williams meets the boy of her nightmares — Death himself. Unbeknownst to her, Death has come to collect on a forgotten promise Faith made long ago. But when she refuses to comply, Faith's reality twist into something unrecognizable. Torn between Death’s dark pull and her growing connection to David Star— a golden boy with secrets of his own - Faith is left questioning everything and everyone. With the truth buried in her past, Faith must uncover who she really is...before Death finally claims what he was promised.
Source: Webtoon

Deep in the jungle, on an island in Polynesia, an ancient temple has been uncovered. For reasons he keeps secret, businessman Caleb Makoa has hired archeologist Dr. Issac Gideon and his team to uncover the temple's mysteries. Now the two of them are tangled together as they try to escape the temple and everything inside. Will they make it out alive?
Source: Manta Comics

Weisshorn looks like a sugar-coated dreamland of smiling mascots, endless parades, and a Leader who loves you. But for Nel, it’s a lie. Branded a terrorist, she joins a rebel gang to tear it all down. The deeper she digs, the weirder it gets–strange visions, ghosts, and secrets buried for a reason. Some dreams are designed to keep you asleep. But if breaking free means letting go of everything that held her together? Then that's the price.
Source: Webtoon

Riku and Cherry have always hated each other. So how are they supposed to co-parent an egg together? They're totally scrambled. Forced together for their senior project, sparks fly when these two boys try to keep both their egg baby--and their feelings--uncracked.
Source: Webtoon

Living in a contaminated zone under the constant threat of the Crimson Cloud and its acidic Red Rain, all Mani wants is to protect and provide for his younger siblings. Thankfully, as one of the few who can survive the Red Rain, a 'Bleacher', he has been able to do that so far. However, when faced with the very weight of the world coming for him and his siblings, what will his soul drive him to do to protect them? To break through Red Rain? Or perhaps... to bleach the Crimson Cloud above?
Source: Webtoon

Samurai Appa and Ronin Momo roam the Four Nations, righting wrongs wherever they go. In this special ATLA FCBD tale, the sky bison and winged lemur find themselves at a beleaguered Fire Nation noodle house where some of the clientele are tougher customers than the owner would like. Can the duo bring some order to chaos--and maybe earn themselves lunch in the process? Or will they be out on their tails?

Kasai was only a boy when he watched his parents die, not from blades or bullets, but as their very souls were ripped away. No one believed him. No one but Naraka, a ruthless mafia syndicate that raised him into their perfect weapon. Now, years later, Kasai has escaped the underworld, desperate to bury his bloodstained past. But when Naraka comes hunting, fate delivers him into the hands of a mysterious group of assassins that are after Naraka, known as Soul Hunters. But their killings don’t end with the body; they annihilate the soul itself, preventing their targets from reincarnation. For Kasai, they may also hold the truth about the night his parents were killed. To uncover what really happened, and finally break free from Naraka, Kasai must hunt the very Mafia family that forged the monster he has become.

(Source: Webtoons)

When a young man vanishes without a trace, destiny hurls him onto an enigmatic island that holds an unreal mystery. Amidst the untamed beauty and lurking danger, he is struck by a revelation that shakes the very core of his existence. Now, with the island as his unlikely crucible, every moment challenges him to forge a new path, unravel ancient enigmas, and confront the shadows of his past. In the heart of this tempest, one resounding truth echoes through the chaos: Never Give Up.

A man named Dunky goes on adventures in his wacky world, but due to his addictive nature, happens upon some very dire situations.

(Source: Webtoons)

Amber’s tarot-reading business might be a flop, but it does lead the dangerously charming and very real seer Gareth right to her tent. Invited to a secret society of witches who do readings for the rich and influential, Amber follows Gareth into the coven’s prestigious Gallery. There, she finds herself in a whole new world of nature defying powers... and crime.
Source: Webtoon

The public bathroom at the mall is haunted... but no one has noticed?! Easily distracted but determined to achieve her goals, this ghost girl will have to work hard to give people a good fright!
Source: Webtoon

Queen Clara of Balladene is in a tough spot! After her sudden coronation takes her from carefree student to queen overnight, she faces the impossible task of holding court with excessively judgement lords. But a new face appears in court, albeit behind a jingling jester’s mask, and this handsome jester has a proposal: use the power of goofs and gossip to sway the lords. With few allies in the castle, will a friendship with the court jester bring Clara more ridicule or a path to rule on her own terms? And just who is this mysterious jester, anyway?
Source: Webtoon

After suffering her own heartbreak, Melissa devoted her life to creating peoples’ perfect weddings. Her professional and emotional worlds collide spectacularly when a dream client walks into her office, only for Melissa to learn that the bride-to-be’s fiancé is none other than the man she once planned to marry. Will she subtly sabotage the one who broke her heart or will the forced proximity allow them to address unresolved feelings to rekindle or finally move on?
Source: Webtoon

What is Jasha's worse offense: that he's magicless? Or that he's a boy? Adopted into an all-girls academy, his classmates - all aspiring to the Sisterhood and its White Magic - are eager to remind him his faults daily. Eager to fit in, growing up makes Jasha only grow more desperate - perhaps desperate enough to break the Academy's one cardinal rule...
Source: Webtoon

Kuro's dreams come true. So when he dreams about a falling meteor, and walking through the woods at 3 am to hear a voice calling out "Help me!"—that's exactly what he does. In the midst of a storm, Kuro saves the meteor's tiny alien pilot, a sludgy little guy who fits into a Slushie cup. Slushii is very cute, super friendly . . . and clearly hiding something. What he does admit is so bizarre, Kuro can't believe it. A dimension for dreamers? A conqueror with a grudge against sentient beings? And the most amazing (and terrifying) claim of all: could Kuro's dreams really do more than predict the future?
Source: Webtoon

When a dead officer’s badge falls into Vano Grice’s hands, he enters the city’s hidden war with soul devouring Shadows. The badge links him to the SDU, a monster hunting organization where his sister Cleo serves. As the power within his soul awakens, the work pulls him deeper and raises doubts about the truth at home.
Source: Webtoon

Ilea Spears wanted a fight, not a life behind a desk. So when this boxer-turned-med student wakes up in Elos -- a dangerous fantasy world where combat is a daily requirement -- she’s more than a little thrilled. There, she unlocks the long-lost Battle Healer class, an unusual blend of combat strength and healing magic, and discovers she may have finally found her calling. As she travels across the realms, leveling up faster than anyone expects, she begins to earn a reputation as something of a legend: the healer who isn’t afraid to punch back.
Source: Webtoon

James Rayner has long endured the Council’s oppressive rule over the society of other creatures—but everything changes when he meets Kenta, a spirited werewolf working at a quiet convenience store. What begins as an unlikely friendship turns into something deeper, and the mark they share awakens an ancient power the Council both fears and covets. As love and destiny collide, James must face a choice: protect their bond or risk watching their world burn.
Source: Webtoon

In a world of magic and demons, Willow - the most powerful witch of her generation - has only one goal: discover the truth behind her mother's death. The most likely suspects? The royal family. So when Willow is given the rare opportunity to mentor the Crown Prince, she eagerly does so. But little did she know the secrets - and passion - she and the prince would uncover...
Source: Webtoon

Travel to a parallel universe where the shogunate still rules Japan and the evil Kingpin, Wilson Fisk has fled America to establish himself as Governor of Edo. Spider-Man, Miles Morales, and Ghost-Spider are hot on his trail. But the Kingpin has a trick up his sleeve: He's brought an alien parasite capable of granting extraordinary powers. When a young man named Hyo accidentally bonds with the symbiote and seemingly transforms into the infamous Venom, things go from bad to worse!
Source: Graphix

Ilex Davenport had it all—a noble title, top grades at the academy, and a reputation as its biggest playboy. He was living proof the world wasn't fair. Tilia Ambrose hated him for it. While he coasted through life, she was fighting to escape her toxic family. So how did she end up in his bed?
Source: Manta

Selah Cardi is a former marine biology student who woke up in a romance novel as an inconsequential extra. Eager to survive the plot, Selah manages to rescue Maria so that she and Duke Herbert, her fiancé, will be indebted to her. But then Admiral Ellaim notices her and her magical abilities that allow her to breathe underwater. Selah soon discovers that Ellaim is a merman called a siren, and that he needs her powers to recover from a mysterious illness. Will her dream of retiring by the sea in peace ever come true?

After years in the criminal underworld, Dao Tongda faces death with nothing to show for his life except a handful of coins. But the heavens grant him an impossible miracle when he wakes up in the body of his 18-year-old self. Reuniting with old friends at the Guanghua Road Fixer Agency, he sets out to claim the power and wealth that once escaped him. But in a world ruled by blood and betrayal, can Tongda rewrite his fate and claim the throne of the night? Or is history doomed to repeat itself?

Source: Tapas

Yesol Kim has a celebrity crush. Okay, an obsession, but who doesn’t fantasize about getting intimate with movie stars? It didn’t mean anything was out of the ordinary—at least, not until a succubus interrupted her fantasies to tell her she could make men do whatever she wanted in the pursuit of some naughty fun. It couldn’t possibly have been more than a dream... But she doesn’t have anything to lose by testing it out either, does she? And if it is real, just how far can she take this power?

Source: Tapas

After the fall of the Kingdom of Solaris to the Demon King Zermes, a princess and her queen mother are captured and branded with a cursed Pleasure Mark. To protect her daughter, the queen embraces corruption, while the princess loses her last hope. And day by day, both are broken down and forced to submit to the Demon King's pleasure.
Source: Toptoon

When ordinary man Mooyeong awakens as an A-rank guide, he is shocked to find out he has been paired with his long-lost first love from high school: the elite S-rank esper Yoohae. Although Yoohae is delighted about their reunion, Mooyeong is determined to keep their relationship a professional one. And thus begins an endless amount of “work” as a guide. While it’s standard protocol for guides to heal through physical intimacy, Yoohae’s demands are obsessively intense, pushing Mooyeong to his limits. Is this so-called business relationship going to work out?

Source: TappyToon

Born with monstrous strength, Macaron Spartan dreams of living as a proper noble lady, but her father insists she follow the warrior fate of House Spartan. Thanks to the unexpected help of a mysterious boy named Ganache, she briefly enters high society and tastes the life she longs for. However, that fragile dream fades as a dark plague spreads across the land, forcing her to wield the strength she wished to cast aside. Can Macaron save the world and still claim the gentle life she desires?

Summer, 1994. Seojin is hiding from debt collectors in the middle of nowhere, facing a fate worse than bankruptcy: manual labor. When a sudden stomach ache leads to a messy disaster in a neighbor’s field, Seojin is caught red-handed by the hulking owner, Cheol. Cheol helps Seojin handle his spicy peppers by day, and Seojin returns the favor by night. Seojin thinks he’s just using the local hunk for "farm assistance," but this country boy’s heat might be too much to handle!

*"I shall wait for you at the edge of the Abyss..."* 

That is what a mysterious man said to Sora Mukujima in one of his dreams.

Sora lived a modest life together with his parents, until one day, that peaceful life fell apart. A massive tower appeared. His brother, a soldier, was unreachable. And monsters began to attack suddenly. When he was in a desperate situation, the man from his dream appeared before him. And when he woke up next, he was in an unfamiliar place. It was a different world called the "Abyss", just as the man had called it in his dream. 

In order to return to his original world and save his family, Sora vows to challenge the Abyss, fight, and grow stronger at all costs!

description:
Yuzuki’s first love and husband, Ayato Kuze—the one and only heir to the Kyūshi Group. An arrogant man, yet endowed with nobility and grace. Married to a husband who took no interest in his wife, their marriage was never destined to succeed. On the very day she resolved to divorce him, he died saving her. The reason he sacrificed himself for her remained a mystery… After his death, Yuzuki learned that his passing was blamed on “the Kuze family’s curse,” and that she had been forced into marriage as a substitute victim of that curse. Still reeling from the shock, she was headed toward the mortuary when she tumbled down the stairs… When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to one year earlier—the day she first met him. Standing before the man she loved once more, Yuzuki made a solemn vow: whatever the reason for their marriage… “This time, by marrying you, I will save you.”
